items.title: 〈台灣大法說〉成長動能多軌並進 上修全年營業利益成長7至9%
items.title_en: Taiwan Mobile's Investor Day: Multi‑Track Growth Momentum, Raises Full‑Year Operating Profit Growth to 7‑9%
paras: 台灣大(3045-TW)今(14)日召開法說會，總經理林之晨指出，台灣大成長動能多軌並進，核心電信事業與momo業務穩健成長，企業電信事業及新科技事業也加速擴張，在不含精誠資訊(6214-TW)收購案影響下，上修營業利益成長7至9%。
根據台灣大1月公布的業績展望，預估合併營收成長5至7%，其中，電信業務與其他業務皆成長5至7%；合併營業利益成長1至2%，其中，電信營業利益成長4至6%，合併營益率約9至11%。
台灣大指出，在不含精誠資訊購案影響下，上修全年獲利展望，合併營業利益成長上修至7至9%，其中，電信業務營業利益則上調為13至15%，合併營益率上調至10至12%。另外，合併營收則維持先前看法。
林之晨提到，除Telco電信本業、Telco+企業電信事業，以及Telco+Tech科技電信事業三大成長引擎持續加速，台灣大也搶占AI代理時代的Alpha先機，提供企業級AIDC與AICT解決方案。
台灣大第二季營收 494.3 億元，季減 0.7%，年增 4.15%；EBITDA 114.97 億元，季增 1.26%，年增 8.56%；稅後純益 45.5 億元，季增 9.64%，年增 38.72%，創近20年新高，每股純益 1.49 元。
台灣大累計今年前 6 月營收 992.1 億元，年增 3.74%；EBITDA 228.51 億元，年增 8.07%；稅後純益 86.9 億元，年增 25.22%，每股純益 2.86 元。
paras_en: Taiwan Mobile (3045‑TW) held its investor day today (the 14th). General Manager Lin Chih‑chen said the company’s growth momentum is advancing on multiple tracks: the core telecom business and the momo e‑commerce unit are growing steadily, while the enterprise telecom and new technology segments are expanding faster. Excluding the impact of the acquisition of Jingcheng Information (6214‑TW), the company has raised its operating‑profit growth outlook to 7‑9%.

According to the outlook released in January, Taiwan Mobile forecasts consolidated revenue to grow 5‑7%, with both telecom and other businesses each contributing 5‑7% growth. Consolidated operating profit is expected to rise 1‑2%, with telecom operating profit increasing 4‑6%, and the overall operating margin projected at roughly 9‑11%.

Taiwan Mobile noted that, without the effect of the Jingcheng Information acquisition, it is upgrading its full‑year profit outlook: consolidated operating profit growth is now expected at 7‑9%, and telecom operating profit is lifted to 13‑15%. The consolidated operating margin is revised up to 10‑12%. The consolidated revenue outlook remains unchanged.

Lin Chih‑chen added that, beyond the three main growth engines – the core Telco business, Telco + Enterprise telecom, and Telco + Tech telecom – Taiwan Mobile is also seizing the early‑alpha opportunity of the AI‑agent era, offering enterprise‑grade AIDC and AICT solutions.

In the second quarter, Taiwan Mobile posted revenue of NT$49.43 billion, down 0.7% quarter‑over‑quarter but up 4.15% year‑over‑year; EBITDA was NT$11.497 billion, up 1.26% QoQ and 8.56% YoY; net profit after tax was NT$4.55 billion, up 9.64% QoQ and 38.72% YoY, a near‑20‑year high, with earnings per share of NT$1.49.

For the first six months of the year, Taiwan Mobile’s cumulative revenue reached NT$99.21 billion, up 3.74% YoY; EBITDA was NT$22.851 billion, up 8.07% YoY; net profit after tax was NT$8.69 billion, up 25.22% YoY, with earnings per share of NT$2.86.

items.title: 技嘉Q2大賺近1個股本 年增逾1倍 上修資本支出至28-30億元
paras: PC品牌技嘉(2376-TW)今(14)日公佈第二季財報，第二季稅後純益66.1億元，年增逾一倍，每股純益9.86元；累計上半年稅後純益118.7億元，年增 92.6 %，每股純益 17.73 元；技嘉表示，看好客戶下半年需求持續強勁，已上修資本支出至28至30億元。
技嘉第二季營收 1442.1 億元，季增 37.3 %，年增 41.0 %；毛利率 9.6 %，季減 2.4 個百分點，年增 0.2 個百分點；營業利益 81.2億 元，季增 9.5 %，年增 53.4 %；營益率 5.6 %，季減 1.4 個百分點，年增 0.5 個百分點。稅後純益 66.1 億元，季增 25.4 %，年增 116.6 %，每股純益 9.86 元。
技嘉上半年累計營收 2492.7 億元，年增 48.4 %；毛利率 10.6 %，年減 0.2 個百分點；營業利益 155.3億元，年增 63.0 %；營益率 6.2 %，年增 0.6 個百分點；稅後純益 118.7 億元，年增 92.6 %，每股純益 17.73 元。
技嘉將全年資本支出從23-25億元區間，上修至28-30億元；展望下半年，技嘉看好AI客戶算力需求強烈，也帶動訂單能見度提高，隨著基礎設施進度及關鍵零組件配改善，出貨可望更加順暢。
技嘉表示，為因應營運擴張及海外採購料件所需資金，技嘉董事會決議辦理現金增資發行普通股40000仟股至50000仟股以參與發行海外存託憑證，每股面額新台幣10元，增資資金用途全數鎖定外幣購料。

items.title: 地緣政治與聯準會政策迷霧 黃金從十周高點回落
items.title_en: Geopolitics and Fed Policy Uncertainty Weigh on Gold Prices
paras: 黃金價格周五(14日)小幅走低，從本周創下的十周高點回落。由於投資者在經歷一波強勁漲勢後選擇獲利了結，加上中東地緣政治局勢與美國聯準會(Fed)未來的政策動向仍充滿不確定性，金價呈現高檔震盪。
現貨黃金在亞市午盤下跌 0.4% 至每盎司 4,334.48 美元，黃金期貨則下跌 0.7% 至 4,390.30 美元。儘管今日走勢回軟，但黃金本周仍有望實現連續第二周的周線增長。
支撐金價的主要因素在於美國近期公布的經濟數據。7 月份生產者物價指數(PPI)與消費者物價指數(CPI)均顯示通膨壓力相對受控，其中 PPI 表現低於市場預期。
澳盛銀行(ANZ)指出，這強化了聯準會可能在 9 月維持利率不變的論點。目前市場預測 9 月升息的機率僅約三分之一，投資者正密切關注聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)即將在傑克遜霍爾(Jackson Hole)全球央行年會上的發言。
然而，通膨前景仍與中東局勢緊密相連。華盛頓與德黑蘭之間關於結束衝突及重新開放荷姆茲海峽的努力陷入僵局。隨著美國威脅將對伊朗實施無限期海上封鎖，以及該地區頻發的油輪襲擊事件，能源供應中斷的風險持續存在。
分析指出，若衝突再次升溫推動油價上漲，可能引發通膨反彈，進而迫使聯準會採取更緊縮的貨幣政策。 反之，若水路能持續開放，則有望緩解自 2 月下旬美伊戰爭爆發以來的通膨風險。
在技術面上，金價近期一度突破 100 日移動平均線這一重要關卡，但隨後因獲利了結賣壓而回落至該線下方。儘管如此，黃金在 4,000 美元整數關卡上方仍具備支撐力道，這主要歸功於投資者需求的回升，以及各國央行(特別是中國)的強勁購買。
paras_en: Gold prices fell slightly on Friday, retreating from a 10-week high set earlier in the week. Investors chose to lock in profits after a strong rally, and uncertainty over the Middle East geopolitical situation and the US Federal Reserve's (Fed) future policy direction led to a high-profile volatility in gold prices.

Spot gold fell 0.4% to $4,334.48 an ounce in the Asian session, while gold futures fell 0.7% to $4,390.30. Despite the softer tone today, gold is still expected to post a second consecutive weekly gain this week.

The main support for gold prices comes from the recent US economic data. The July producer price index (PPI) and consumer price index (CPI) showed that inflationary pressures are relatively contained, with PPI coming in below market expectations.

ANZ Bank noted that this reinforced the argument that the Fed may keep interest rates unchanged in September. The market currently predicts a probability of around one-third of a September rate hike, with investors closely watching the speech of Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh at the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Conference.

However, the inflation outlook remains closely tied to the Middle East situation. Efforts by Washington and Tehran to end the conflict and reopen the Strait of Hormuz have stalled. With the US threatening to impose an indefinite maritime blockade on Iran, and frequent oil tanker attacks in the region, the risk of energy supply disruptions persists.

Analysts point out that if the conflict escalates and drives up oil prices, it could trigger an inflation rebound, forcing the Fed to adopt a more contractionary monetary policy. Conversely, if the waterway remains open, it could alleviate the inflation risk that has persisted since the US-Iran war broke out in late February.

Technically, gold prices recently broke above the 100-day moving average, a key level, but then fell back below it due to profit-taking selling pressure. Despite this, gold remains supported above the $4,000 psychological level, mainly due to the resurgence in investor demand and strong buying from central banks (notably China).

items.title: 公股金控獲利飆速！第一金前7月站上200億里程碑 合庫金年增3成續創同期高
paras: 公股金控前七月獲利版圖揭曉，繼兆豐金、華南金之後，第一金控（2892-TW）合庫金（5880-TW）同步於今（14）日公布最新自結獲利，受惠銀行，證券及壽險子公司同步挹注，第一金累計前7月稅後純益達209.37億元、年增23.6%，每股稅後純益（EPS）1.46元，改寫歷年同期新高，也正式躋身「200億元俱樂部」。合庫金不遑多讓，前7月合併稅後純益160.77億元，年增幅高達33.2%，續創歷年同期新高，旗下銀行、證券及壽險前7月獲利也同步改寫同期新高紀錄，繳出亮麗成績單。
第一金7月單月稅後純益31.39億元，較6月成長4.7%，年增4.84%。其中，核心獲利引擎第一銀行表現亮眼，受惠股利收入進帳，帶動金融交易收益大幅成長，推升7月單月稅後純益衝上32.02億元，不僅月增27.1%，更較去年同期成長16.23%，創下歷史單月新高紀錄。
第一銀行指出，除了股利收入貢獻外，淨利息收入及淨手續費收入仍維持穩健成長動能，資產品質亦持續維持高檔水準。截至7月底止，逾放比維持在0.16%，覆蓋率則進一步提升至876.8%。累計前7月稅後純益達186.58億元，較去年同期成長12.7%。
除了銀行本業穩健成長外，第一金旗下證券事業今年更成為獲利黑馬。第一金證券7月稅後純益1.21億元，受到台股回檔影響，經紀手續費收入與投資收益同步下滑，單月獲利月減58.4%、年減2.42%。不過，在上半年股市交投熱絡帶動下，累計前7月稅後純益仍達15.31億元，較去年同期大增262.9%，不僅提前超越去年全年獲利，更刷新歷史紀錄。
壽險子公司方面，第一金人壽受惠投資收益增加，7月稅後淨利1.75億元，較上月大增160.6%，年增44.63%；累計前7月稅後淨利則達5.93億元，持續為集團貢獻獲利動能。
另一方面，同屬公股金控的合庫金亦交出亮眼成績單。合庫金7月單月合併稅後純益26.77億元，累計前7月合併稅後淨利達160.77億元，較去年同期增加40.07億元，年增幅高達33.2%，續創歷年同期新高。
觀察合庫金旗下主要子公司表現，銀行、證券及壽險三大事業前7月獲利全數改寫同期新高紀錄。其中，核心子公司合庫銀行累計稅後淨利142.55億元，年增12.55%，穩居主要獲利來源。
值得注意的是，合庫證券今年獲利成長幅度最為驚人，累計前7月稅後淨利達13.61億元，較去年同期大增13.33億元，幾乎呈現倍數成長。合庫人壽則受惠投資及保險業務表現改善，累計稅後淨利11.28億元，較去年同期增加9.19億元，年增約4.4倍，展現強勁獲利爆發力。

items.title: 群創Q2純益創近6季高EPS0.57 元 上半年每股賺0.77元
paras: 面板大廠群創(3481-TW)今(14)日公告第二季財報，稅後純益45.32億元，季增178%、較去年同期轉盈，每股純益0.57元；上半年稅後純益61.61億元，年增29倍，每股純益0.77元。
群創第二季營收637億元，季減4.42%、年增13.28%、毛利率14.56%，季增0.13個百分點、年增6.18個百分點、營業利益16.33億元，季增9%，較去年同期虧轉盈、營業利益率2.56%，季增0.32個百分點、較去年同期負轉正。
群創上半年營收1303.44億元，年增16.21%、毛利率14.50%，年增6.52個百分點、營業利益31.32億元，年減255.26%、營業利益率2.40%，年增4.20個百分點。
群創說明，第二季品牌廠拉貨力道趨緩，但公司透過優化產品組合及提升高毛利業務，使得本季毛利率與 EBITDA 利益率較上季微幅提升，並連續四個季度獲利，展現穩健的營運韌性與獲利能力。
群創第二季營收以產品應用別區分，車用39%、電視27%、手機及商用16%、可攜式電腦15%、桌上型螢幕3%；顯示器領域群及非顯示器領域群營收佔比為60%及40%，其中顯示器領域群區分消費性顯示器及商用顯示器營收佔比47%及13%。

items.title: 主計總處估今年台灣GDP將衝上11.05% 創近40年來最高
paras: 主計總處今(14)日公布今明年台灣經濟成長率(GDP)最新預測值，由於上半年經濟成長14.15%，上修1.50個百分點，下半年預測成長8.27%，上修1.33個百分點，使全年GDP將衝上11.05%，上修1.41個百分點，創1988年以來最高紀錄，而消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率2.07%略高於台灣央行通膨警戒線2%。
主計總處預測，今年GDP規模1兆536億美元，每人GDP 4萬5332美元，經濟成長11.05%，上修1.41個百分點，而明年GDP仍可達 6.04%，每人GDP 4萬9874美元，CPI增幅則略降至1.90%。
主計總處指出，外需動能熱絡，我國具優勢的AI供應鏈出口大幅擴增，傳產貨品出口也回溫，加上記憶體等關鍵零組件供需緊俏推升價格，全年商品出口估達9036億美元，年增41.19%，而商品進口受出口及投資引申需求影響達6875億美元，年增42.19%。
整體來看，今年我國輸出實質成長21.28%，上修1.35個百分點，輸入實質成長21.15%，上修3.85個百分點。
展望明年，主計總處說明，主要CSP業者雖面臨自由現金流縮減壓力，但AI長期成長趨勢不變，預估資本支出仍續擴增，加上我國業者因應客戶強勁需求，加速開出高階產能，出口動能可望延續，預測商品出口1兆725億美元，年增18.70%，進口7923億美元，年增15.23%，併計商品與服務並剔除物價因素，輸出入分別實質成長11.53%和10.07%。
內需方面，由於企業獲利表現亮眼，推升股市創高，再加上就業市場持續改善，挹注家庭財富及所得，車市買氣隨關稅衝擊淡化回升，以及金融市場交易熱絡等，預測全年民間消費實質成長4.76%，上修1.16個百分點，明年仍成長2.81%。
民間投資方面，國內半導體、封裝測試、記憶體、載板及設備等相關供應鏈廠商擴產步調積極，廠房及設備投資力道強勁，全年民間投資實質成長11.58%，上修5.15個百分點。
對於物價，主計總處估計， 近期天候及AI需求推升消費電子零組件成本，商品類價格漲幅逐漸擴大，且服務類漲勢料將延續，預測全年CPI年增 2.07%，上修0.14個百分點，明年略降至1.90%。

items.title: OpenAI Astra陷「抄襲門」？數學突破引發學術倫理爭議
items.title_en: OpenAI's Astra Accused of Plagiarism? Mathematical Breakthrough Sparks Academic Ethics Debate
paras: OpenAI 近期宣布其下一代大型語言模型「Astra」在數學領域取得重大進展，成功攻克 10 項長期懸而未決的難題，涵蓋高維幾何、群論及量子複雜度等領域。然而，這項被譽為 AI 「登月時刻」的成就，隨即遭到多位數學家指控涉及學術不端與抄襲，引發科技界與學術界的劇烈辯論。
根據 OpenAI 發布的 249 頁技術報告，Astra 僅花費約 2,000 美元的詞元(token)成本，便產出了包括「高維球體堆積」(Sphere Packing)與「非 sofic 群」(Non-sofic Group)存在性證明在內的十項成果。OpenAI 強調，雖然人類研究員協助了手稿準備與 Lean 形式化證明的檢驗，但核心數學論證完全由 AI 生成，因此將功勞歸於 AI 系統。
然而，這項宣稱在發布五天後便面臨挑戰。耶希瓦大學(Yeshiva University)數學家Steven Miller在接受《科學美國人》採訪時直指，Astra 在處理球體堆積問題時，其最核心的論證邏輯完全來自他與合作者於 2016 年發表的論文，但 Astra 在初版報告中並未引用該研究，而是將其呈現為「原創發現」。Miller認為這並非偶然疏漏，而是「系統性的學術不端」。
針對另一個關於「非 sofic 群」的突破，劍橋大學群論學家Francesco Fournier-Facio學術標準約束。
面對質疑，OpenAI 發言人回應表示將對論文進行「小幅更新」以修正引用問題，並重申對結果正確性負責。此事件不僅反映出 AI 在加速科學發現上的潛力，也暴露出當前 AI 模型在原創精神歸屬與學術引用規範上的法律與道德盲區。
這場爭議也延伸至數學本質的討論。部分學者批評 Astra 產出的數十萬行形式化代碼雖然能通過機器編譯，卻缺乏人類證明中能提供啟發性的「對稱性」或洞見。
數學家們擔憂，當 AI 成為研究協作者時，如何界定「原創」並保護人類智力勞動的署名權，將是未來科學研究轉型期必須面對的挑戰。
paras_en: OpenAI recently announced that its next‑generation large language model “Astra” has achieved a major breakthrough in mathematics, solving ten long‑standing open problems spanning high‑dimensional geometry, group theory, and quantum complexity. The achievement, hailed as an AI “moon landing,” was immediately challenged by several mathematicians who allege academic misconduct and plagiarism, sparking a heated debate between the tech and academic communities.

According to OpenAI’s 249‑page technical report, Astra produced ten results—including proofs of a high‑dimensional sphere‑packing problem and the existence of a non‑sofic group—at a token cost of roughly $2,000. OpenAI stressed that while human researchers helped prepare the manuscript and verify Lean formalizations, the core mathematical arguments were generated entirely by the AI, and thus the credit belongs to the system.

However, the claim was contested just five days after release. Yeshiva University mathematician Steven Miller told Scientific American that Astra’s central logical reasoning for the sphere‑packing problem was taken verbatim from a paper he co‑authored in 2016, yet the initial report failed to cite that work and presented it as an original discovery. Miller said this was not a simple oversight but a “systemic academic misconduct.”
Regarding the claimed breakthrough on non‑sofic groups, Cambridge University group‑theory specialist Francesco Fournier‑Facio raised concerns about academic standards and proper attribution.

In response to the criticism, an OpenAI spokesperson said the paper would receive a “minor update” to correct citation errors and reiterated the company’s responsibility for the correctness of the results. The episode highlights both the potential of AI to accelerate scientific discovery and the current legal and ethical gray areas surrounding originality and citation practices in AI‑generated research.

The controversy also sparked a broader discussion about the nature of mathematics itself. Some scholars argue that, although Astra’s formal code—running into hundreds of thousands of lines—passes machine verification, it lacks the insightful “symmetry” and intuition that human proofs typically provide.

Mathematicians worry that as AI becomes a research collaborator, defining “originality” and protecting the authorship rights of human intellectual labor will be a crucial challenge during the transformation of scientific research.

items.title: 千附實業上半年營收創同期新高 稅後賺回3億元EPS達2.66元
items.title_en: Qianfu Industrial Posts Record H1 Revenue, Post‑Tax Profit Returns to NT$300 million, EPS Reaches 2.66
paras: 原爲水資源概念股的千附實業 (8383-TW) 今 (14) 日公布最新財報獲利資訊，2026 年第二季千附實業稅後純益1.82億元，季增55.52%，年增3.17倍每股純益1.62元，2026年上半年稅後純益3億元，年增1.44倍，每股純益達2.66元。
千附實業 2026 年第二季營收 14.09 億元，創新高，毛利率22.49%，季減3.68個百分點，年減3.04個百分點，2026年 第二季千附實業稅後純益1.82億元，季增55.52%，年增3.17倍，每股純益1.62元。
千附實業 2026年1-6月營收24.14億元，創同期新高，毛利率24.03%，年減3.67個百分點，2026年上半年稅後純益3億元，年增1.44倍，每股純益達2.66元。
千附實業指出，近年全球AI、高效能運算(HPC)及先進製程需求持續推升半導體資本支出，樂觀將帶動台灣各大半導體廠建廠擴線需求，相關投資效益也將逐步由晶圓製造端往設備、材料及廠務工程供應鏈擴散，其中涵蓋氣體供應、化學品配送等管線建構配置領域，為千附半導體廠務工程業務帶來穩健且長期的市場需求。

在半導體廠務工程佈局上，千附過去以二次配工程為主要核心，近年來積極跨入一次配工程領域，除可承接更大型工程案、擴大整體營收規模外，亦能與既有二次配工程、駐廠服務及自有高階管材產品形成綜效。公司指出，即便一次配工程毛利率相對較低，然具備工程金額大、案件規模高特性，隨著一次配工程占比提升，短期將使整體毛利率受到結構性影響，長期來看透過營收規模放大、固定營運成本攤提效益提升，以及一次配與二次配工程相互帶動，整體獲利仍可望維持穩健成長。
二次配工程是在廠房或建築物的基礎結構與主系統（一次配）完工後，將個別製程機台或生產設備，連接到主幹管、電力盤與排氣口等主系統的末端管線安裝工程。這是讓設備能夠通電、通氣、通水並正式運轉的關鍵最後一哩路。
子公司千附精密(6829-TW)方面，千附精密2026年上半年營運表現穩健，繳出營收11.7億元、稅後純益1.77億元及每股純益2.99的佳績。在業務佈局上，千附精密成功跨足量子電腦市場，繼第一季完成首套客製化超低溫真空腔體出貨後，第二套產品也將於8月完成出貨並認列營收，成為高附加價值業務的新動能。
展望下半年及未來營運，千附在AI、高效能運算及先進製程所帶動的全球半導體擴產趨勢仍未改變，伴隨大型晶圓廠持續擴大資本支出，廠務工程市場的需求能見度仍高；公司將持續擴大一次配工程承攬能力，並透過一次配、二次配、駐廠服務及管材產品的整合，放大既有客戶合作綜效。
千附實業表示，將持續掌握AI半導體擴產及高階精密製造兩大產業趨勢，透過「工程規模擴大＋產品結構升級＋新興應用拓展」三大策略，推升營收與獲利同步成長，對下半年及中長期營運展望維持正向積極看法。
paras_en: Qianfu Industrial (8383‑TW), originally classified as a water‑resource concept stock, announced its latest financial results today (14th). In Q2 2026 the company posted a post‑tax net profit of NT$182 million, up 55.52% quarter‑over‑quarter and 3.17‑fold year‑over‑year, with earnings per share of NT$1.62. For the first half of 2026, post‑tax net profit reached NT$300 million, a 1.44‑fold increase year‑over‑year, and earnings per share rose to NT$2.66.

Qianfu Industrial’s Q2 2026 revenue was NT$1.409 billion, a new high, with a gross margin of 22.49%, down 3.68 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter and 3.04 points year‑over‑year. The quarter’s post‑tax net profit was NT$182 million, up 55.52% quarter‑over‑quarter and 3.17‑fold year‑over‑year, yielding earnings per share of NT$1.62.

For the January‑June 2026 period, Qianfu Industrial generated revenue of NT$2.414 billion, a record for the same period, with a gross margin of 24.03%, down 3.67 percentage points year‑over‑year. The half‑year post‑tax net profit was NT$300 million, a 1.44‑fold increase year‑over‑year, and earnings per share reached NT$2.66.

Qianfu notes that global demand for AI, high‑performance computing (HPC) and advanced processes has been continuously boosting semiconductor capital expenditures. This is expected to drive Taiwanese semiconductor fabs to expand capacity, spreading investment benefits from wafer fabrication to equipment, materials and plant‑engineering supply chains, including gas supply and chemical delivery infrastructure, providing steady, long‑term market demand for Qianfu’s semiconductor plant‑engineering business.

In its plant‑engineering portfolio, Qianfu has traditionally focused on secondary (back‑end) distribution projects. In recent years it has actively entered the primary (front‑end) distribution segment, which allows it to take on larger projects and expand overall revenue scale, while creating synergies with existing secondary distribution, on‑site services and its own high‑end pipe products. The company acknowledges that primary distribution projects have lower gross margins, but their large contract values and scale will temporarily exert a structural impact on overall margins as their share rises. Over the long term, however, profit is expected to remain robust thanks to revenue scaling, better absorption of fixed operating costs, and mutual reinforcement between primary and secondary projects.

Secondary distribution projects involve installing end‑point piping that connects individual process machines or production equipment to the main trunk lines, power panels and exhaust outlets after the plant’s basic structure and primary systems are completed. This “last‑mile” work is essential for powering, ventilating, supplying water to, and commissioning the equipment.

Regarding its subsidiary Qianfu Precision (6829‑TW), the unit delivered solid performance in the first half of 2026, reporting revenue of NT$1.17 billion, post‑tax net profit of NT$177 million and earnings per share of NT$2.99. In terms of business development, Qianfu Precision successfully entered the quantum‑computer market; after shipping its first custom ultra‑low‑temperature vacuum chamber in Q1, a second unit will be shipped in August and recognized as revenue, providing a new high‑value‑added growth driver.

Looking ahead to the second half and beyond, Qianfu sees the global semiconductor expansion driven by AI, HPC and advanced processes as unchanged. With large wafer fabs continuing to increase capital spending, the demand outlook for plant‑engineering services remains strong. The company will keep expanding its capability to undertake primary distribution projects and, through integration of primary and secondary distribution, on‑site services and pipe products, amplify the synergies with existing customers.

Qianfu Industrial says it will continue to capture the two major industry trends of AI‑driven semiconductor expansion and high‑precision manufacturing, leveraging three strategic pillars—scale‑up of engineering projects, product‑mix upgrade and expansion into emerging applications—to boost revenue and profit together, and maintains a positive, proactive outlook for the second half and the medium‑to‑long term.

items.title: 〈台灣大法說〉成長動能多軌並進 上修全年營業利益成長7至9%
items.title_en: Taiwan Mobile's Investor Day: Multi‑Track Growth Momentum, Raises Full‑Year Operating Profit Growth to 7‑9%
paras: 台灣大(3045-TW)今(14)日召開法說會，總經理林之晨指出，台灣大成長動能多軌並進，核心電信事業與momo業務穩健成長，企業電信事業及新科技事業也加速擴張，在不含精誠資訊(6214-TW)收購案影響下，上修營業利益成長7至9%。
根據台灣大1月公布的業績展望，預估合併營收成長5至7%，其中，電信業務與其他業務皆成長5至7%；合併營業利益成長1至2%，其中，電信營業利益成長4至6%，合併營益率約9至11%。
台灣大指出，在不含精誠資訊購案影響下，上修全年獲利展望，合併營業利益成長上修至7至9%，其中，電信業務營業利益則上調為13至15%，合併營益率上調至10至12%。另外，合併營收則維持先前看法。
林之晨提到，除Telco電信本業、Telco+企業電信事業，以及Telco+Tech科技電信事業三大成長引擎持續加速，台灣大也搶占AI代理時代的Alpha先機，提供企業級AIDC與AICT解決方案。
台灣大第二季營收 494.3 億元，季減 0.7%，年增 4.15%；EBITDA 114.97 億元，季增 1.26%，年增 8.56%；稅後純益 45.5 億元，季增 9.64%，年增 38.72%，創近20年新高，每股純益 1.49 元。
台灣大累計今年前 6 月營收 992.1 億元，年增 3.74%；EBITDA 228.51 億元，年增 8.07%；稅後純益 86.9 億元，年增 25.22%，每股純益 2.86 元。
paras_en: Taiwan Mobile (3045‑TW) held its investor day today (the 14th). General Manager Lin Chih‑chen said the company’s growth momentum is advancing on multiple tracks: the core telecom business and the momo e‑commerce unit are growing steadily, while the enterprise telecom and new technology segments are expanding faster. Excluding the impact of the acquisition of Jingcheng Information (6214‑TW), the company has raised its operating‑profit growth outlook to 7‑9%.

According to the outlook released in January, Taiwan Mobile forecasts consolidated revenue to grow 5‑7%, with both telecom and other businesses each contributing 5‑7% growth. Consolidated operating profit is expected to rise 1‑2%, with telecom operating profit increasing 4‑6%, and the overall operating margin projected at roughly 9‑11%.

Taiwan Mobile noted that, without the effect of the Jingcheng Information acquisition, it is upgrading its full‑year profit outlook: consolidated operating profit growth is now expected at 7‑9%, and telecom operating profit is lifted to 13‑15%. The consolidated operating margin is revised up to 10‑12%. The consolidated revenue outlook remains unchanged.

Lin Chih‑chen added that, beyond the three main growth engines – the core Telco business, Telco + Enterprise telecom, and Telco + Tech telecom – Taiwan Mobile is also seizing the early‑alpha opportunity of the AI‑agent era, offering enterprise‑grade AIDC and AICT solutions.

In the second quarter, Taiwan Mobile posted revenue of NT$49.43 billion, down 0.7% quarter‑over‑quarter but up 4.15% year‑over‑year; EBITDA was NT$11.497 billion, up 1.26% QoQ and 8.56% YoY; net profit after tax was NT$4.55 billion, up 9.64% QoQ and 38.72% YoY, a near‑20‑year high, with earnings per share of NT$1.49.

For the first six months of the year, Taiwan Mobile’s cumulative revenue reached NT$99.21 billion, up 3.74% YoY; EBITDA was NT$22.851 billion, up 8.07% YoY; net profit after tax was NT$8.69 billion, up 25.22% YoY, with earnings per share of NT$2.86.

items.title: 公股金控獲利飆速！第一金前7月站上200億里程碑 合庫金年增3成續創同期高
paras: 公股金控前七月獲利版圖揭曉，繼兆豐金、華南金之後，第一金控（2892-TW）合庫金（5880-TW）同步於今（14）日公布最新自結獲利，受惠銀行，證券及壽險子公司同步挹注，第一金累計前7月稅後純益達209.37億元、年增23.6%，每股稅後純益（EPS）1.46元，改寫歷年同期新高，也正式躋身「200億元俱樂部」。合庫金不遑多讓，前7月合併稅後純益160.77億元，年增幅高達33.2%，續創歷年同期新高，旗下銀行、證券及壽險前7月獲利也同步改寫同期新高紀錄，繳出亮麗成績單。
第一金7月單月稅後純益31.39億元，較6月成長4.7%，年增4.84%。其中，核心獲利引擎第一銀行表現亮眼，受惠股利收入進帳，帶動金融交易收益大幅成長，推升7月單月稅後純益衝上32.02億元，不僅月增27.1%，更較去年同期成長16.23%，創下歷史單月新高紀錄。
第一銀行指出，除了股利收入貢獻外，淨利息收入及淨手續費收入仍維持穩健成長動能，資產品質亦持續維持高檔水準。截至7月底止，逾放比維持在0.16%，覆蓋率則進一步提升至876.8%。累計前7月稅後純益達186.58億元，較去年同期成長12.7%。
除了銀行本業穩健成長外，第一金旗下證券事業今年更成為獲利黑馬。第一金證券7月稅後純益1.21億元，受到台股回檔影響，經紀手續費收入與投資收益同步下滑，單月獲利月減58.4%、年減2.42%。不過，在上半年股市交投熱絡帶動下，累計前7月稅後純益仍達15.31億元，較去年同期大增262.9%，不僅提前超越去年全年獲利，更刷新歷史紀錄。
壽險子公司方面，第一金人壽受惠投資收益增加，7月稅後淨利1.75億元，較上月大增160.6%，年增44.63%；累計前7月稅後淨利則達5.93億元，持續為集團貢獻獲利動能。
另一方面，同屬公股金控的合庫金亦交出亮眼成績單。合庫金7月單月合併稅後純益26.77億元，累計前7月合併稅後淨利達160.77億元，較去年同期增加40.07億元，年增幅高達33.2%，續創歷年同期新高。
觀察合庫金旗下主要子公司表現，銀行、證券及壽險三大事業前7月獲利全數改寫同期新高紀錄。其中，核心子公司合庫銀行累計稅後淨利142.55億元，年增12.55%，穩居主要獲利來源。
值得注意的是，合庫證券今年獲利成長幅度最為驚人，累計前7月稅後淨利達13.61億元，較去年同期大增13.33億元，幾乎呈現倍數成長。合庫人壽則受惠投資及保險業務表現改善，累計稅後淨利11.28億元，較去年同期增加9.19億元，年增約4.4倍，展現強勁獲利爆發力。

items.title: 主計總處估今年台灣GDP將衝上11.05% 創近40年來最高
paras: 主計總處今(14)日公布今明年台灣經濟成長率(GDP)最新預測值，由於上半年經濟成長14.15%，上修1.50個百分點，下半年預測成長8.27%，上修1.33個百分點，使全年GDP將衝上11.05%，上修1.41個百分點，創1988年以來最高紀錄，而消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率2.07%略高於台灣央行通膨警戒線2%。
主計總處預測，今年GDP規模1兆536億美元，每人GDP 4萬5332美元，經濟成長11.05%，上修1.41個百分點，而明年GDP仍可達 6.04%，每人GDP 4萬9874美元，CPI增幅則略降至1.90%。
主計總處指出，外需動能熱絡，我國具優勢的AI供應鏈出口大幅擴增，傳產貨品出口也回溫，加上記憶體等關鍵零組件供需緊俏推升價格，全年商品出口估達9036億美元，年增41.19%，而商品進口受出口及投資引申需求影響達6875億美元，年增42.19%。
整體來看，今年我國輸出實質成長21.28%，上修1.35個百分點，輸入實質成長21.15%，上修3.85個百分點。
展望明年，主計總處說明，主要CSP業者雖面臨自由現金流縮減壓力，但AI長期成長趨勢不變，預估資本支出仍續擴增，加上我國業者因應客戶強勁需求，加速開出高階產能，出口動能可望延續，預測商品出口1兆725億美元，年增18.70%，進口7923億美元，年增15.23%，併計商品與服務並剔除物價因素，輸出入分別實質成長11.53%和10.07%。
內需方面，由於企業獲利表現亮眼，推升股市創高，再加上就業市場持續改善，挹注家庭財富及所得，車市買氣隨關稅衝擊淡化回升，以及金融市場交易熱絡等，預測全年民間消費實質成長4.76%，上修1.16個百分點，明年仍成長2.81%。
民間投資方面，國內半導體、封裝測試、記憶體、載板及設備等相關供應鏈廠商擴產步調積極，廠房及設備投資力道強勁，全年民間投資實質成長11.58%，上修5.15個百分點。
對於物價，主計總處估計， 近期天候及AI需求推升消費電子零組件成本，商品類價格漲幅逐漸擴大，且服務類漲勢料將延續，預測全年CPI年增 2.07%，上修0.14個百分點，明年略降至1.90%。

items.title: 千附實業上半年營收創同期新高 稅後賺回3億元EPS達2.66元
items.title_en: Qianfu Industrial Posts Record H1 Revenue, Post‑Tax Profit Returns to NT$300 million, EPS Reaches 2.66
paras: 原爲水資源概念股的千附實業 (8383-TW) 今 (14) 日公布最新財報獲利資訊，2026 年第二季千附實業稅後純益1.82億元，季增55.52%，年增3.17倍每股純益1.62元，2026年上半年稅後純益3億元，年增1.44倍，每股純益達2.66元。
千附實業 2026 年第二季營收 14.09 億元，創新高，毛利率22.49%，季減3.68個百分點，年減3.04個百分點，2026年 第二季千附實業稅後純益1.82億元，季增55.52%，年增3.17倍，每股純益1.62元。
千附實業 2026年1-6月營收24.14億元，創同期新高，毛利率24.03%，年減3.67個百分點，2026年上半年稅後純益3億元，年增1.44倍，每股純益達2.66元。
千附實業指出，近年全球AI、高效能運算(HPC)及先進製程需求持續推升半導體資本支出，樂觀將帶動台灣各大半導體廠建廠擴線需求，相關投資效益也將逐步由晶圓製造端往設備、材料及廠務工程供應鏈擴散，其中涵蓋氣體供應、化學品配送等管線建構配置領域，為千附半導體廠務工程業務帶來穩健且長期的市場需求。

在半導體廠務工程佈局上，千附過去以二次配工程為主要核心，近年來積極跨入一次配工程領域，除可承接更大型工程案、擴大整體營收規模外，亦能與既有二次配工程、駐廠服務及自有高階管材產品形成綜效。公司指出，即便一次配工程毛利率相對較低，然具備工程金額大、案件規模高特性，隨著一次配工程占比提升，短期將使整體毛利率受到結構性影響，長期來看透過營收規模放大、固定營運成本攤提效益提升，以及一次配與二次配工程相互帶動，整體獲利仍可望維持穩健成長。
二次配工程是在廠房或建築物的基礎結構與主系統（一次配）完工後，將個別製程機台或生產設備，連接到主幹管、電力盤與排氣口等主系統的末端管線安裝工程。這是讓設備能夠通電、通氣、通水並正式運轉的關鍵最後一哩路。
子公司千附精密(6829-TW)方面，千附精密2026年上半年營運表現穩健，繳出營收11.7億元、稅後純益1.77億元及每股純益2.99的佳績。在業務佈局上，千附精密成功跨足量子電腦市場，繼第一季完成首套客製化超低溫真空腔體出貨後，第二套產品也將於8月完成出貨並認列營收，成為高附加價值業務的新動能。
展望下半年及未來營運，千附在AI、高效能運算及先進製程所帶動的全球半導體擴產趨勢仍未改變，伴隨大型晶圓廠持續擴大資本支出，廠務工程市場的需求能見度仍高；公司將持續擴大一次配工程承攬能力，並透過一次配、二次配、駐廠服務及管材產品的整合，放大既有客戶合作綜效。
千附實業表示，將持續掌握AI半導體擴產及高階精密製造兩大產業趨勢，透過「工程規模擴大＋產品結構升級＋新興應用拓展」三大策略，推升營收與獲利同步成長，對下半年及中長期營運展望維持正向積極看法。
paras_en: Qianfu Industrial (8383‑TW), originally classified as a water‑resource concept stock, announced its latest financial results today (14th). In Q2 2026 the company posted a post‑tax net profit of NT$182 million, up 55.52% quarter‑over‑quarter and 3.17‑fold year‑over‑year, with earnings per share of NT$1.62. For the first half of 2026, post‑tax net profit reached NT$300 million, a 1.44‑fold increase year‑over‑year, and earnings per share rose to NT$2.66.

Qianfu Industrial’s Q2 2026 revenue was NT$1.409 billion, a new high, with a gross margin of 22.49%, down 3.68 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter and 3.04 points year‑over‑year. The quarter’s post‑tax net profit was NT$182 million, up 55.52% quarter‑over‑quarter and 3.17‑fold year‑over‑year, yielding earnings per share of NT$1.62.

For the January‑June 2026 period, Qianfu Industrial generated revenue of NT$2.414 billion, a record for the same period, with a gross margin of 24.03%, down 3.67 percentage points year‑over‑year. The half‑year post‑tax net profit was NT$300 million, a 1.44‑fold increase year‑over‑year, and earnings per share reached NT$2.66.

Qianfu notes that global demand for AI, high‑performance computing (HPC) and advanced processes has been continuously boosting semiconductor capital expenditures. This is expected to drive Taiwanese semiconductor fabs to expand capacity, spreading investment benefits from wafer fabrication to equipment, materials and plant‑engineering supply chains, including gas supply and chemical delivery infrastructure, providing steady, long‑term market demand for Qianfu’s semiconductor plant‑engineering business.

In its plant‑engineering portfolio, Qianfu has traditionally focused on secondary (back‑end) distribution projects. In recent years it has actively entered the primary (front‑end) distribution segment, which allows it to take on larger projects and expand overall revenue scale, while creating synergies with existing secondary distribution, on‑site services and its own high‑end pipe products. The company acknowledges that primary distribution projects have lower gross margins, but their large contract values and scale will temporarily exert a structural impact on overall margins as their share rises. Over the long term, however, profit is expected to remain robust thanks to revenue scaling, better absorption of fixed operating costs, and mutual reinforcement between primary and secondary projects.

Secondary distribution projects involve installing end‑point piping that connects individual process machines or production equipment to the main trunk lines, power panels and exhaust outlets after the plant’s basic structure and primary systems are completed. This “last‑mile” work is essential for powering, ventilating, supplying water to, and commissioning the equipment.

Regarding its subsidiary Qianfu Precision (6829‑TW), the unit delivered solid performance in the first half of 2026, reporting revenue of NT$1.17 billion, post‑tax net profit of NT$177 million and earnings per share of NT$2.99. In terms of business development, Qianfu Precision successfully entered the quantum‑computer market; after shipping its first custom ultra‑low‑temperature vacuum chamber in Q1, a second unit will be shipped in August and recognized as revenue, providing a new high‑value‑added growth driver.

Looking ahead to the second half and beyond, Qianfu sees the global semiconductor expansion driven by AI, HPC and advanced processes as unchanged. With large wafer fabs continuing to increase capital spending, the demand outlook for plant‑engineering services remains strong. The company will keep expanding its capability to undertake primary distribution projects and, through integration of primary and secondary distribution, on‑site services and pipe products, amplify the synergies with existing customers.

Qianfu Industrial says it will continue to capture the two major industry trends of AI‑driven semiconductor expansion and high‑precision manufacturing, leveraging three strategic pillars—scale‑up of engineering projects, product‑mix upgrade and expansion into emerging applications—to boost revenue and profit together, and maintains a positive, proactive outlook for the second half and the medium‑to‑long term.

items.title: 榮成上半年獲利2.43億元由虧轉盈 下半年進到旺季營運審慎樂觀
items.title_en: Everwin Posts NT$2.43 Billion Net Profit in First Half, Sees Optimistic Outlook for Second Half
paras: 榮成(1909-TW)今(14)日召開法說會，累計今年上半年稅後純益2.43億元，較去年同期轉虧為盈，每股純益0.19元。榮成指出，隨著進到下半年的傳統旺季，可望帶動工業包裝紙需求提升，對於下半年營運持審慎樂觀看法。
榮成表示，時序進到下半年傳統旺季，包括中秋、十一長假、電商購物節以及海外耶誕備貨需求，都可望推升工業包裝紙需求。此外，中國上半年出口雙位數成長，電商物流及快遞市場持續擴大，也對下半年包裝用紙需求帶來支撐。
榮成進一步針對中國市場指出，第一季開始市場即出現正向訊號，包含工紙價格回升、供需結構改善，以及主要紙廠維持供給，價格競爭的問題也逐步趨緩。
榮成表示，中國 7月底至 8 月初的工紙價格，雖受到第二季漲幅較高，出現部分高檔整理，但整體供需狀況仍維持健康，產業庫存天數也保持相對低水位，未看到需求明顯轉弱，後續視旺季拉貨情形，紙價仍有機會走高。整體而言，認為中國市場已走出過去幾年景氣低點，正逐步改善。
至於南崁廠資產活化進度，榮成說明，目前照計劃持續推動，並透露已有潛在買方洽詢中。
針對周三(12日)宣布轉型為投控公司，榮成也再次重申，從現階段至明年1月4日轉型生效日前，所有營運均照常進行。1月4日轉型後，原有生產製造及營運業務，將由分割後子公司承接，既有工廠、生產、客戶與供應商合作關係均維持運作，並順利銜接。
榮成累計今年上半年營收242.47億元，年增13%；毛利率10.9%，年增1.6個百分點；營益率1%，較去年同期轉正；稅後純益2.43億元，較去年同期轉虧為盈，每股純益0.19元。
paras_en: Everwin (1909-TW) held a shareholders' meeting today (August 14), reporting a net profit of NT$2.43 billion for the first half of the year, a turnaround from a loss in the same period last year. The company's net profit per share was NT$0.19.

Everwin noted that the start of the traditional peak season in the second half of the year, including the Mid-Autumn Festival, National Day, e-commerce shopping festivals, and overseas Christmas pre-orders, is expected to drive up demand for industrial packaging paper. Additionally, China's export growth in the first half of the year and the continued expansion of e-commerce logistics and express delivery markets are expected to support demand for packaging paper in the second half.

Everwin further pointed out that the Chinese market has shown positive signals since the start of the first quarter, including rising paper prices, improved supply and demand structures, and main paper mills maintaining supply, with price competition gradually easing.

Everwin noted that China's paper prices at the end of July and early August were affected by the high second-quarter growth rate, resulting in some high-end adjustments, but the overall supply and demand situation remained healthy, with industry inventory days remaining at a relatively low level. There was no visible weakening of demand, and paper prices may still have room to rise, depending on the peak season's inventory situation.
Regarding the progress of asset revitalization at the Nanxian factory, Everwin stated that it is proceeding according to plan and has already received inquiries from potential buyers.

Everwin also reiterated that all operations will continue as usual from the present stage to January 4, 2024, when the transformation into a holding company takes effect. After January 4, the original production, manufacturing, and operation businesses will be taken over by the split-off subsidiaries, with existing factories, production, customers, and supplier relationships remaining intact and smoothly transitioning.

Everwin reported total revenue of NT$242.47 billion for the first half of the year, up 13% year-over-year; gross margin of 10.9%, up 1.6 percentage points year-over-year; operating margin of 1%, turning positive from a loss in the same period last year; net profit of NT$2.43 billion, turning a profit from a loss in the same period last year; and net profit per share of NT$0.19.

items.title: AI時代「記憶體即石油」 ！SK集團會長崔泰源：2027年將是晶片短缺最慘烈一年
paras: 南韓SK集團會長近日接受《CNBC》專訪時就7200億美元擴產賭注、與黃仁勳私交、HBM供應瓶頸、美國建廠壓力與AI 對人類社會的深遠影響進行深度討論，這位掌管逾百家子公司的南韓財閥掌門人罕見地坦承：「2027年可能是記憶體短缺最嚴重一年，所有人都想要更多晶片，但我們給不出來。」
SK集團旗下擁有超過100家子公司，但崔泰源毫不諱言，目前集團最核心的引擎是SK海力士。他比喻道：「現在是AI時代，AI就像一個四歲小孩，隨著它成長，需要更多功能、更多經驗和知識，而這些都必須存在某個地方。」
為支撐這波需求，SK海力士已宣布未來五年投入高達7200億美元擴建產能。崔泰源預估，未來五年全球AI智能體數量將較 2025 年暴增 77 倍，十年內記憶體總需求將逼近當前產能的五倍。「我們必須迅速擴張，否則供應跟不上。」
他進一步指出，目前DRAM(含HBM)約佔SK海力士營收的四分之三。但這波擴產並非盲目衝量，HBM生產佔用的晶圓產能是普通DRAM的4倍以上，大幅擠壓整體晶圓空間。
SK集團已意識到過剩風險，正透過長期協議(LTA)、晶圓廠合資與「記憶體即服務」(MaaS)等模式分攤風險。崔泰源說：「我們每次擴張都會檢查需求是否真實存在，既不希望供過於求，也不希望供不應求。」
訪談中最令人警醒的一段，是崔泰源對「晶片通膨」的坦承。他透露，記憶體價格今年來已漲40%至50%，就連蘋果這類消費電子巨頭都不得不將成本轉嫁給消費者。
崔泰源說：「晶片價格太高，結果就是全社會的價格水平都會被推高。我並不希望如此，但它已經發生了。」
更嚴峻的是供給缺口。崔泰源直言擴建一座晶圓廠至少需要四到五年準備期，而「明年可能是最艱難的一年」。沒有一家記憶體公司準備好擴大產能，但需求料將較今年翻倍。「這就像一場戰爭，每個人都想要更多記憶體晶片。」他甚至證實，南韓各地飯店早已擠滿前來簽署LTA的全球科技巨頭高層。
崔泰源在訪談中展現驚人的「人脈版圖」。他展示一片有黃仁勳簽名的晶圓，並透露與微軟執行長Satya Nadella、谷歌執行長Sundar Pichai、Meta執行長Mark Zuckerberg等超大规模雲端客戶負責人都是朋友，經常交流產業展望。
當談及台積電，崔泰源稱約一個月前才跟魏哲家會面。「沒有基礎裸片(base die)就無法生產 AI 產品。我相信他當然會為我們生產。」
他也強調，台積電與SK海力士是互補關係，記憶體充足但台積電產能有限，GPU照樣出不來，反之亦然。
對於輝達作為最大客戶的集中度風險，崔泰源並不避諱地說，「沒有輝達，今天的AI生態系就不會存在。我必須盡我所能支持他」，但稱谷歌、微軟等客戶也自行設計晶片，並非單一依賴。
針對華府近期施壓SK海力士與三星在美建立完整記憶體晶圓廠一事，崔泰源坦言，美國客戶確實希望SK海力士在美設廠，但稱建廠決策不能草率。「一座晶圓廠背後需要600至700家材料、化學品與服務供應商組成的產業生態系。除水、電、土地外，生態系同樣是關鍵。」
目前，SK海力士已在印第安納州推進項目，並成立「美國AI公司」與投入100億美元，目標是結合美國軟體實力與亞洲硬體製造優勢。此外，SK海力士已進入美國資本市場融資，為全球擴張與人才激勵打開新資金管道。
訪談尾聲，崔泰源對記憶體產業的週期性提出深刻見解。他表示，過去記憶體景氣取決於全球人口數量與硬體設備數量，「人們不會一天買十支手機，但AI時代不同，一個人可能同時擁有十個不同的AI智能體，每個智能體都需要大量記憶體。
崔泰源說：「週期不會消失，但運行方式必然改變，它可能變成一個長得多的週期。」
從1997年金融危機時的瀕臨破產，到2023年的艱困調整，崔泰源認為這次最大不同是「AI 這個新生兒」。他既看到AI消耗大量能源、水與材料的挑戰，也相信AI將解放人類勞動、縮小社會差距。
崔泰源說：「我們不必再那麼辛苦地工作，如果人與人之間的差異也隨之縮小，就更有機會建設一個幸福的社會。」
在記憶體這條被稱為「現代石油」的賽道上，崔泰源正帶領SK海力士押上全部身家，而他的判斷只有一句話：「至少在不久的將來，我看到需求仍會非常強勁，這一點是確定的。」

items.title: 應用材料Q4展望優於預期仍跌5%市場憂成長落後同業
paras: 2026年08月14日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 應用材料Applied Materials(AMAT-US)週五盤前股價下跌約5%，儘管公司公布優於市場預期的2026會計年度第4季財測，但在股價今年已上漲約1倍後，投資人對成長要求提高，加上半導體設備市場競爭加劇，亮眼財測仍未能消除市場疑慮。
應用材料預估會計年度第4季營收約102.5億美元，高於市場預估的95.4億美元，毛利率預估維持在50.4%。不過，市場更關注公司能否在晶圓廠設備市場取得高於同業的成長，尤其科林研發Lam Research(LRCX-US)與科磊KLA(KLAC-US)先前均繳出強勁業績，艾司摩爾ASML(ASML-US)也已上調2026年展望。
市場分析認為，應用材料近期營收成長速度落後部分主要競爭對手，使投資人即使面對優於預期的財測，仍對後續市占率與成長動能保持謹慎。
估值方面，應用材料預估本益比約32.14倍，低於Lam Research的34.59倍、KLA的36.85倍及ASML的33.39倍。半導體設備股估值普遍處於較高水準，也意味市場對成長放緩的容忍度降低，財測優於預期已不足以單獨推升股價。

items.title: 頂尖研究員余家輝宣布離開 Meta祭高薪挖角卻仍難留住人才
paras: Meta 超級智能實驗室(Meta Superintelligence Labs, MSL)核心成員、多模態研究負責人余家輝(Jiahui Yu)周五(14日)正式宣布離職，並計畫創辦新公司。
余家輝自 2025 年 6 月加入 Meta 以來，帶領團隊推出了 Muse 系列原生多模態模型，是 Meta 近年來在生成式人工智慧(Generative AI)領域的重要戰力。

從學霸到頂尖工程師

余家輝的學術與職業生涯始終環繞著「多模態」技術。他出身於中國科學技術大學少年班，隨後取得伊利諾大學厄巴納－香檳分校(UIUC)博士學位，師從知名電腦視覺學者黃煦濤。
在進入 Meta 之前，他已是 AI 界公認的頂尖人才，曾參與 Google 的 Gemini 專案，並擔任 OpenAI 感知(Perception)團隊負責人，主導 GPT-4o 及 o 系列推理模型的研發。
加入 Meta 後，余家輝擔任超級智能實驗室旗下 TBD Lab 的多模態技術負責人。他在離職公告中表示，過去一年在 Meta 與執行長祖克柏(Mark Zuckerberg)及首席 AI 官 Alexandr Wang 共同建設 TBD Lab 的經歷
「極具啟發且充實」。

Muse 系列產品線完備

在余家輝任職的 14 個月內，TBD Lab 完成了密集的產品發布。從 2026 年 4 月推出的基礎模型 Muse Spark 開始，標誌著 Meta 的前沿模型研發重心從 Llama 系列轉向更具備多模態能力的 Muse 系列。隨後，團隊接連推出 Voice Mode、Muse Image 與 Muse Video，全面覆蓋語音、影像與影片生成領域。
就在他宣布辭職前八天，Meta 才剛發布 Muse Spark 1.2，進一步強化了智慧代理人(Agent)能力與長程任務執行潛力。

九位數年薪爭議

關於余家輝的待遇，市場曾盛傳 Meta 以高達「1 億美元年薪」的創紀錄條件將他從 OpenAI 挖角。儘管 Meta 並未證實確切數字，但 CTO Andrew Bosworth曾針對市場傳言澄清，所謂的高額報酬並非一次性領取的簽約獎金，而是包含股票、獎金與績效條件的四年期總酬勞方案。
針對這種重金挖角的現象，OpenAI 執行長 Sam Altman 曾評論認為：「傳教士最終會擊敗僱傭兵(Missionaries will eventually beat the mercenaries)」。
隨著余家輝在短期內完成階段性任務後離職創業，科技作者 Gergely Orosz 指出，Meta 內部的組織重組與效率調整導致工程師產生不安感，許多資深專家開始對外部機會保持開放態度。

Meta 面臨人才流失挑戰

關於創業動向，余家輝並未透露新公司的細節，僅表示一個「對人類未來極其重要，但目前尚未被充分探索的問題」正吸引著他全部的注意力。
研究平台 alphaXiv 數據顯示，包含余家輝在內，Meta 已流失超過 200 名知名研究員，總計有 929 位研究人員處於「曾在 Meta 工作但已離職」的狀態。雖然 Meta 能夠透過短期高額報酬追趕技術差距，但如何修復組織信任並留住頂尖人才，仍是未來的重要挑戰。

items.title: 巴菲特指標飆至238%歷史新高 但美股照漲不誤
paras: 美股標普500指數漲勢未歇，截至 8 月 12 日，今年已創造 14% 的總報酬，這還是在 2025 年 18% 的強勁漲幅，以及前兩年的雙位數增長之後的表現。然而，在投資大眾慶祝獲利的同時，市場估值指標正發出前所未有的警號。
由波克夏·海瑟威(Berkshire Hathaway)前執行長華倫·巴菲特(Warren Buffett)提出的「巴菲特指標」，正處於令人不安的高點。

什麼是巴菲特指標？

巴菲特指標於 2001 年首度被提及，其計算方式是將美國股市的總市值除以美國的GDP。這項指標就像是針對整個國家經濟與股市的「本益比」(P/E ratio)，被視為衡量市場估值的重要量規。
目前，巴菲特指標已攀升至 238% 的歷史新高，意味著股市總價值已高達美國經濟規模的 2.4 倍。若以 100% 為合理估值的基準線，當前的讀數顯然暗示市場正處於隨時可能破裂的泡沫之中。

指標的局限性與當前市場現實

儘管數值驚人，但這一指標近年來局限性愈加明顯。首先，許多美國大型企業擁有龐大的跨國業務，其獲利高度依賴全球市場，而不僅僅是美國本土，這會導致此比率被放大。
另外，2026 年的市場結構已與往昔大不相同。以技術密集型為主的企業主導了市場，這些公司即便規模龐大，仍能保持快速增長並擁有強大的競爭優勢，且許多企業正處於人工智慧(AI)熱潮的核心，這可能成為未來主要的成長催化劑。

歷史教訓：為何不應嘗試「擇時交易」

面對極高的估值，投資人往往會產生賣出離場、等待修正再重新買入的念頭。然而，歷史數據顯示這種「擇時交易」極具風險。
回顧過去十年的數據，儘管十年前巴菲特指標已達 121%(在當時被視為極其昂貴)，但 S&P 500 指數隨後仍創造了 318% 的總報酬。當時因為擔憂估值而清空投資組合的投資人，錯失了整整十年的豐厚收益。

專家建議：保持耐心，待在市場

據《The Motley Fool》報導指出，在巴菲特指標高達 238% 的當下，投資人最明智的舉動並非驚慌拋售，而是避免嘗試預測進場與出場時機。雖然高估值令人不安，但長期投資成功的核心原則是「待在市場的時間」而非「擇時能力」。
報導稱，雖然無法保證未來的十年能複製過去的表現，但在股市中，耐心往往會得到回報。面對高漲的行情，保持原有策略、持續留在市場中，才是獲取長期成功的關鍵。

items.title: 標普500再創歷史新高 20大功臣出爐、SanDisk暴漲逾5倍居冠

items.title: 次貸危機2.0？輝達5000億美元GPU算力證券化 華爾街嗅到2008年味道：離AIG時刻只差一根稻草
items.title_en: Subprime Crisis 2.0? Nvidia’s $500 Billion GPU Compute Securitisation Gives Wall Street a Taste of 2008: Only a Straw Away from an AIG Moment
paras: 輝達再次傳出將資料中心資產證券化的計畫，這筆可能高達數千億美元的交易，正將全球AI算力熱潮推向一個危險的新階段。
彭博宏觀策略師Simon White出具最新研報直言，輝達打算將資料中心轉化為可投資資產的架構，恐致AI算力領域出現嚴重產能過剩，尤其是在「基於結果定價」模式逐漸成為行業標準的背景下。這一判斷核心邏輯令人不寒而慄，因金融化正在人為放大需求信號，掩蓋市場供過於求的真實狀況，運作機制與2008年金融危機前的房市泡沫如出一轍。
White分析指出，輝達此次與Apollo、Brookfield、KKR、黑石、貝萊德及高盛達成的合作框架，意在撬動逾5000億美元資本流入所謂的「AI工廠」。更關鍵的是，輝達將為部分交易中最高25%的GPU抵押品提供保險，實質上為其回收價值提供支撐。這與當年AIG為CDO優先級別債券出售保險、讓銀行得以減少資本佔用，並分發更多有毒債務的歷史軌跡高度吻合，最終在相關性驟升時逼的國家出手相救。
White更將此比作「GPU債券市場的AIG時刻」。他指出，這場AI基礎設施熱潮在規模上已超越1960年代的美國州際公路建設與2000年代的寬頻鋪設，光是跟輝達交叉融資與供應商資助交易規模就高達7500億美元。
輝達執行長黃仁勳的目標很明確，也就是將「AI工廠算力」打造成一種全新的可投資資產類別。GPU支持的債務市場今年已呈爆發式增長，而此次新協議將進程推向更深層次的資產證券化與分發。合作夥伴將提供資本、基礎設施專業知識，並推動證券化流通。透過提升交易吸引力，輝達將使債務結構中的優先級別債券獲得更高信用評級。
與此同時，美國證交會(SEC)剛剛放寬了資料中心債券的證券化規則。White將此比作金融危機期間退休基金最終入場的時間點，這往往標誌著風險開始向更廣泛的負債端擴散，也是危機走向終局的起點。
表面上看，輝達的風險或許有限，但White提醒，這正是AIG當年判斷。隨著時間推移，AIG承接越來越多自認為無風險且有利可圖的義務，最終發現借款人信用壓力的相關性上升足以釀成災難。
需求方面，White指出衡量標準本身正在發生根本性轉變。GPU租賃的標準計量單位是每小時成本，推理環節則是處理每個token的成本，但對終端用戶真正重要的是輸出結果。智能成本正在下降，但這一變化未立即反映在GPU層面的定價上。若一個模型能用少10倍的token完成同樣任務，而GPU的每token定價不變，那麼每塊GPU的實際效率就相當於提升10倍。
隨著「token最大化」成為歷史，模型在處理同一任務時token用量可大幅波動的證據不斷湧現，加之大模型可被輕易調整以消耗更多token，基於結果的定價模式正日益受到企業用戶的青睞。這一趨勢一旦成為主流，將對模型提供商形成壓力，推動其減少token消耗，進而壓低GPU租賃僲格。
同樣值得關注的是，GPU實質利用率據悉嚴重偏低。根據Cast AI的報告，GPU平均利用率僅為5%，ClearML則發現近半數企業正為閒置晶片浪費「數百萬美元」。這些被金融鍊金術掩蓋的供需失衡信號，恐怕很難在資本狂潮中引起重視。
面對上述效率提升的論據，AI資本支出多頭經常用來反駁的便是傑文斯悖論(Jevons paradox)：算力驅動的智能成本下降，將不可避免地推動需求上升，以量補價。
但White認為，傑文斯悖論無法在所有時間維度上持續奏效。而對市場而言，路徑依賴才是關鍵。他判斷，在當前大模型主導的AI發展階段，智能需求(而非token需求)在現行價格水準上的增速，遲早會放緩到足以引發算力成本長期下行的程度。
作為貸款方，當抵押品相關性開始惡化，借款人的信用狀況也同步走弱時，風險將迅速累積，屆時輝達將不得不履行其保險義務，而與此同時，輝達自身融資的其他交易也可能出現問題，更不用說其核心產品價值的下滑。
此外，Google等同樣以自身資產負債表為這場資本支出熱潮提供支撐的企業，也面臨類似風險。根據2008年房市危機經驗，相關性一旦啟動，便不會停下來等人。
White在報告中的結論是，輝達此次擬議交易，只是讓市場距離再次目睹這一金融自然力量又近了一步。
paras_en: Nvidia is again rumored to be planning to securitise its data‑center assets, a deal that could be worth several hundred billion dollars and is pushing the global AI compute boom into a dangerous new phase.

Bloomberg macro strategist Simon White’s latest research paper bluntly states that Nvidia intends to turn its data centres into investable assets, a move that could create a severe overcapacity in AI compute, especially as a “result‑based pricing” model is becoming the industry norm. The core logic is chilling: financialisation is artificially amplifying demand signals and masking the true oversupply, a mechanism that mirrors the housing bubble before the 2008 financial crisis.

White points out that Nvidia’s partnership framework with Apollo, Brookfield, KKR, BlackRock, Blackstone and Goldman Sachs is designed to pull more than $500 billion of capital into so‑called “AI factories.” More crucially, Nvidia will provide insurance for up to 25% of the GPU collateral in some transactions, effectively supporting the recovery value. This is strikingly similar to how AIG insured senior‑tranche CDO bonds back then, allowing banks to reduce capital charges and distribute more toxic debt, ultimately prompting a government rescue when correlations spiked.

White likens this to an “AIG moment for the GPU bond market.” He notes that the AI infrastructure boom now dwarfs the scale of 1960s U.S. interstate highway construction and 2000s broadband rollout, with cross‑financing and supplier‑backed deals with Nvidia alone reaching $750 billion.

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s goal is clear: to turn “AI‑factory compute” into a brand‑new investable asset class. The GPU‑backed debt market has exploded this year, and the new agreements push the process deeper into securitisation and distribution. Partners will supply capital, infrastructure expertise and help circulate the securities, boosting the appeal of the deals and giving higher‑rated senior bonds better credit ratings.

At the same time, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission has just loosened the rules for securitising data‑center bonds. White compares this to the moment pension funds entered the market during the financial crisis, a signal that risk is spreading to a broader liability side and that the crisis is moving toward its climax.

On the surface Nvidia’s risk may appear limited, but White warns that this is exactly the judgment AIG made back then. Over time AIG took on more and more obligations it thought were risk‑free and profitable, only to discover that rising borrower‑credit correlation was enough to trigger disaster.

On the demand side White says the measurement standard itself is undergoing a fundamental shift. GPU leasing is priced per hour, while the cost of inference is measured per token, yet end‑users care about the output result. Intelligent‑cost is falling, but this change is not immediately reflected in GPU‑level pricing. If a model can complete the same task with ten‑times fewer tokens while the per‑token GPU price stays unchanged, the effective efficiency of each GPU rises tenfold.

As “token maximisation” becomes a thing of the past, evidence is mounting that token usage for the same task can vary wildly, and large models can be easily tweaked to consume more tokens. Result‑based pricing is gaining traction among enterprise users. Once this becomes mainstream it will pressure model providers to cut token consumption, thereby driving down GPU‑leasing rates.

Equally noteworthy is that actual GPU utilisation is reportedly very low. Cast AI reports an average utilisation of only 5%, and ClearML finds that nearly half of firms are wasting “hundreds of millions of dollars” on idle chips. These supply‑demand imbalances, hidden by financial alchemy, are unlikely to attract attention amid the capital frenzy.
When faced with arguments about efficiency gains, AI‑capex bulls often invoke Jevons paradox: lower intelligent‑cost from more compute inevitably spurs higher demand, offsetting price declines.

White argues that Jevons paradox cannot hold indefinitely across all time horizons. For the market, path dependence is key. He judges that in the current large‑model‑driven AI era, the growth rate of intelligent‑demand (not token‑demand) at today’s price levels will eventually slow enough to trigger a long‑term decline in compute costs.

As a lender, when the correlation of the collateral deteriorates and the borrower’s credit weakens simultaneously, risk will accumulate rapidly. Nvidia would then have to honour its insurance obligations, and other financing deals could also falter, not to mention a potential decline in the value of its core products.

Moreover, companies like Google that are also using their balance sheets to fuel this cap‑ex boom face similar risks. History from the 2008 housing crisis shows that once correlation starts, it does not pause for anyone.
White concludes that Nvidia’s proposed transaction simply brings the market one step closer to witnessing this natural financial force in action again.

items.title: 營收上看5000億美元！馬斯克再發豪語： 2027年底xAI資料中心供電容量衝上10GW
items.title_en: Revenue to Look at $50 Billion! Musk Again Makes a Bold Statement: 10GW AI Data Center Power Capacity to Reach 10GW by End of 2027
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，全球首富馬斯克在SpaceX員工會議上透露，旗下 SpaceXAI(原xAI)資料中心電力容量預計明年底前擴大約 7倍，達到10GW，較目前孟菲斯與南海文(Southaven)兩處合計1.4GW暴增逾 6 倍，相當於約1.5 年內完成此一躍進。
美國科技媒體《Tom's Hardware》週四(13日)報導指出，馬斯克在員工大會上宣稱，SpaceXAI已建成「全球最強AI訓練聚落」，並打算明年底前將其規模擴至當前約10 倍。
根據馬斯克估算，若每瓦價值約30至50美元且10GW AI 算力如期上線，xAI每年可創造3000億至5000億美元收入。
不過，業界提醒，資料中心以GW描述供電容量不等於實際算力，冷卻、照明、供配電、網路、儲存與伺服器等系統均會消耗電力，實際可用於運算的比例需視整體基礎設施效率而定。
分析人士指出，馬斯克的擴張藍圖若成真，將使xAI躍居全球AI基礎設施頂尖行列，但也代表著龐大的資本支出與能源挑戰。10GW供電規模約等同於多座大型核電廠的輸出，電力取得、散熱技術與供應鏈排程將是決定這項野心能否落地的關鍵變數，市場後續將密切關注其融資動向與實際建置進度。
paras_en: According to the latest reports from foreign media, the world's richest man, Musk, revealed at a SpaceX employee conference that the power capacity of the SpaceX AI (formerly xAI) data center is expected to expand by approximately 7 times by the end of next year, reaching 10GW, which is more than 6 times the current combined capacity of Memphis and Southaven, equivalent to completing this leap in about 1.5 years.

US tech media Tom's Hardware reported on Thursday (13th) that Musk claimed at the employee conference that SpaceX AI has built the 'world's strongest AI training cluster' and plans to expand its scale to about 10 times the current scale by the end of next year.

According to Musk's estimate, if each watt is valued at around $30 to $50 and the 10GW AI computing power is put into operation as scheduled, xAI can generate $30 billion to $50 billion in revenue per year.

However, the industry reminds that describing the power capacity of the data center in GW does not equal the actual computing power, and the cooling, lighting, power distribution, network, storage, and server systems will all consume electricity, and the actual usable proportion for computation needs to be determined by the overall infrastructure efficiency.

Analysts point out that if Musk's expansion plan comes true, xAI will become the world's leading AI infrastructure, but it also represents a massive capital expenditure and energy challenge. The 10GW power scale is equivalent to the output of multiple large nuclear power plants, and the acquisition of power, heat dissipation technology, and supply chain scheduling will be the key variables that determine whether this ambitious plan can be implemented, and the market will closely follow its financing trends and actual construction progress.

items.title: 超越美光與AMD！戴爾今年股價狂飆285% 美超微亮眼財報指引新榮景
items.title_en: Dell Surpasses Intel and AMD! Dell's Stock Price Soars 285% This Year, Micron Shines in Earnings Report
paras: 戴爾科技(DELL-US)股價今年來累計大漲285%，遠勝市場熱議的人工智慧(AI)建設概念股，瑞穗交易部門分析師Jordan Klein形容其股價表現「瘋狂」，並指出，戴爾股價漲幅已超越「幾乎所有大型科技股」。
受到投資人追捧的美光(MU-US)今年來累計上漲219%，而超微(AMD-US)超微也有126%的漲幅，但都還追不上戴爾。戴爾周四再度收紅，上漲2.1%至每股494.51美元。
香港個人電腦及伺服器製造商聯想集團(Lenovo)(00992-HK)周四公布亮眼財報，調整後獲利大增176%，營收成長43%，該公司把強勁的成長歸因於市場對AI基礎設施需求持續增加。
財報顯示，聯想上季包含AI優化伺服器及個人電腦在內的AI相關營收較去年同期成長60%，目前已占公司總營收的35%。
聯想的財報公布前，美超微(Super Micro Computer)(SMCI-US)周二也發布財報，並給出優於華爾街預期的營收展望。投資人同樣對美超微獲利能力改善感到樂觀，上季調整後毛利率達17.6%，超過原估區間8.2%至8.4%的兩倍以上。
瑞穗的Klein表示，美超微的財報對待爾來說是「非常重要的領先指標」。戴爾預定9月公布財報，他預期AI及企業業務將優於市場預期，並預估總營收成長率將達50-60%**。
美超微周二盤後公布財報後，周三收盤大漲19%，帶動整體半導體類股上揚。新型雲端服務商CoreWeave(CRWV-US)以及光學元件製造商Lumentum Holdings(LITE-US)周二也公布優於預期的財報，進一步提振市場對AI投資概念股的樂觀情緒。
美超微與CoreWeave均指出，未完成訂單持續增加，反映客戶對AI硬體的需求仍然強勁。
美超微上月發布初步財報時曾表示，上季的新訂單金額突破600億美元，使2026會計年度的未完成訂單創下歷史新高。
paras_en: Dell Technologies (DELL-US) stock price has surged 285% this year, far surpassing market hype on artificial intelligence (AI) construction concept stocks. Analyst Jordan Klein from RBC's trading department described the stock price performance as 'crazy' and pointed out that Dell's stock price surge has surpassed 'almost all major tech stocks'.

Dell has been favored by investors, with its stock price rising 219% this year, while Micron (MU-US) has seen a 126% surge, but still trails behind Dell. Dell rose 2.1% to $494.51 per share on Thursday.

Lenovo (00992-HK), a Hong Kong-based personal computer and server manufacturer, reported an impressive earnings report on Thursday, with adjusted profits increasing 176% and revenue growth of 43%. The company attributed its strong growth to the continued increase in demand for AI infrastructure.

The report showed that Lenovo's AI-related revenue, including AI-optimized servers and personal computers, grew 60% year-over-year in the previous quarter, accounting for 35% of the company's total revenue.

Before Lenovo's earnings report, Super Micro Computer (SMCI-US) released its earnings report on Tuesday, exceeding Wall Street's expectations with its revenue outlook. Investors are also optimistic about Micron's improved profitability, with an adjusted gross margin of 17.6% in the previous quarter, more than twice the estimated range of 8.2% to 8.4%.

RBC's Klein stated that Micron's earnings report is 'very important leading indicator' for Dell. Dell is expected to release its earnings report in September, with Klein predicting that AI and enterprise businesses will exceed market expectations, with a total revenue growth rate of 50-60%.

After Micron released its earnings report on Tuesday, it surged 19% on Wednesday, driving the overall semiconductor sector up. CoreWeave (CRWV-US), a new cloud service provider, and Lumentum Holdings (LITE-US), a manufacturer of optical components, also released earnings reports that exceeded expectations on Tuesday, further boosting market sentiment on AI investment concept stocks.
Micron and CoreWeave both pointed out that the number of uncompleted orders continues to increase, reflecting strong demand from customers for AI hardware.

Micron reported in its preliminary earnings report last month that the value of new orders in the previous quarter exceeded $60 billion, setting a new historical high for uncompleted orders in the 2026 fiscal year.

items.title: 生成式AI上市大戰開打！OpenAI年化營收破400億美元 迎戰強敵Anthropic
items.title_en: Generative AI IPO Battle Heats Up: OpenAI's Annual Revenue Surpasses $40 Billion, Challenging Anthropic
paras: 知情人士透露，從目前的營運表現推測，OpenAI的營收年化預估值(run rate)即將突破400億美元，與2025年底相比已成長一倍，這有助於OpenAI正在籌備的首次公開發行(IPO)，也凸顯其與Anthropic之間日益激烈的商業競爭。
彭博引述的知情人士說，OpenAI近幾個月以來的營收加速成長，原因包括訂閱銷售需求強勁、廣告業務開始展露頭角，以及專業軟體產品持續成長，尤其是Codex程式碼代理工具，以及針對企業用戶的ChatGPT Work應用程式。此外，核心的消費性業務也繼續成長。
OpenAI正與Anthropic展開激烈的競爭。Anthropic也在加速拓展企業市場，目前已秘密提交上市文件，最快可能搶先OpenAI一步，在今年秋季公開上市。
Anthropic在5月公布的營收年化預估值達470億美元，但由於由於兩家私人新創公司的會計方法不同，不適合直接比較。
為了抵禦國內競爭對手、以及中國低成本競爭者對市占率的威脅，OpenAI積極調整市場拓展及定價策略，例如近期降低部分AI模型的價格，以吸引對成本較為敏感的開發者。
OpenAI最近時也延攬一名資深網路安全高層擔任第二位營收長(CRO)，以強化企業銷售業務，這是OpenAI不到一年內第二度更換營收長。
先前的商業拓展努力似乎開始浮現成果，OpenAI共同創辦人暨總裁Greg Brockman在內部公告中告知員工，光是7月一個月的營收就增加逾20%。
OpenAI在這波大幅成長之前，已經歷一段快速擴張期。OpenAI財務長Sarah Friar此前曾表示，去年底的營收年化預估值已突破200億美元。
paras_en: Sources close to the matter reveal that OpenAI's annual revenue run rate is expected to surpass $40 billion, more than doubling from the end of 2025, which will help the company's initial public offering (IPO) and highlight its intensifying commercial competition with Anthropic.

According to sources cited by Bloomberg, OpenAI's revenue growth has accelerated over the past few months, driven by strong demand for subscription sales, the emergence of advertising business, and the continued growth of professional software products, particularly the Codex code proxy tool and the ChatGPT Work application for corporate users. Additionally, the core consumer business has continued to grow.

OpenAI is engaged in a fierce competition with Anthropic. Anthropic is also accelerating its expansion into the corporate market and has secretly submitted its IPO filing, potentially beating OpenAI to the market and going public as early as this fall.
Anthropic reported an annual revenue run rate of $47 billion in May, but due to differences in accounting methods between the two private startups, the figures are not directly comparable.

To counter domestic competitors and the threat of Chinese low-cost competitors to market share, OpenAI is actively adjusting its market expansion and pricing strategies, including recent price reductions for some AI models to attract developers sensitive to costs.

OpenAI has also recently hired a seasoned network security executive as its second chief revenue officer (CRO) to strengthen its enterprise sales business, which is the company's second CRO change in less than a year.

Previous business expansion efforts seem to be bearing fruit, with OpenAI co-founder and CEO Greg Brockman informing employees in an internal announcement that the company's revenue increased by over 20% in July alone.

Before this significant growth, OpenAI had experienced a period of rapid expansion. OpenAI's CFO Sarah Friar previously stated that the company's annual revenue run rate had surpassed $20 billion at the end of last year.

items.title: 應用材料Q4展望優於預期仍跌5%市場憂成長落後同業
paras: 2026年08月14日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 應用材料Applied Materials(AMAT-US)週五盤前股價下跌約5%，儘管公司公布優於市場預期的2026會計年度第4季財測，但在股價今年已上漲約1倍後，投資人對成長要求提高，加上半導體設備市場競爭加劇，亮眼財測仍未能消除市場疑慮。
應用材料預估會計年度第4季營收約102.5億美元，高於市場預估的95.4億美元，毛利率預估維持在50.4%。不過，市場更關注公司能否在晶圓廠設備市場取得高於同業的成長，尤其科林研發Lam Research(LRCX-US)與科磊KLA(KLAC-US)先前均繳出強勁業績，艾司摩爾ASML(ASML-US)也已上調2026年展望。
市場分析認為，應用材料近期營收成長速度落後部分主要競爭對手，使投資人即使面對優於預期的財測，仍對後續市占率與成長動能保持謹慎。
估值方面，應用材料預估本益比約32.14倍，低於Lam Research的34.59倍、KLA的36.85倍及ASML的33.39倍。半導體設備股估值普遍處於較高水準，也意味市場對成長放緩的容忍度降低，財測優於預期已不足以單獨推升股價。

items.title: 中國核電加速擴張推升全球核能發電量2025年創歷史新高
paras: 2026年08月14日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 全球核能發電量在2025年創下歷史新高，其中中國成為主要成長動能。過去10年間，中國核能發電量已接近增至3倍，隨著新機組持續核准與建設，全球核電產業進入新一波擴張週期。
美國目前仍是全球最大核能發電國，但中國正快速縮小差距。在2座新機組完成併網後，中國核電總裝置容量已接近64 GW，超越法國升居全球第二。自2022年以來，中國已核准49座核反應爐，按照目前擴建速度，核能發電規模未來5年內可能超越美國。
中國近期再核准8座新核反應爐，總投資超過237億美元，反映核電已成為強化能源安全與降低碳排放的重要布局。同時，中國積極推動核電供應鏈國產化，目前已建立涵蓋核燃料、反應爐設計、核島設備、關鍵零組件、工程建設到電廠營運的完整產業鏈，並以國產第三代核電技術「華龍一號」為發展重點。
隨著新機組增加，需求也逐步向設備供應鏈擴散，包括大型鍛件、閥門、風機及工程服務。其中，中核科技(000777-CN)截至2026年5月在手核電訂單約25億元人民幣；江蘇神通閥門(002438-CN)2025年核電業務營收達8.11億元人民幣，年增率9.11%，毛利率38.48%，顯示核電擴建正逐步轉化為設備商訂單與營收。
不過，全球核能發電量雖創新高，占整體能源結構的比重仍小幅下降，主要因全球能源需求成長更快。另一方面，AI與資料中心需要大量且穩定的全天候電力，也讓核電在能源安全與減碳之外，增加新的需求動能。
目前已有超過20個國家規劃擴大核能發電能力。隨著中國持續興建新機組，加上減碳、能源安全及資料中心用電需求增加，全球核電設備、核燃料與相關供應鏈的中長期需求可望同步升溫。

items.title: 缺的不是原油，是煉油產能！全球柴油荒恐延續至2027年
paras: 2026年08月14日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 全球原油需求展望轉弱，但柴油市場正面臨另一套供需邏輯。俄羅斯與中東煉油設施受損、主要航運通道受阻，加上全球庫存偏低及替代產能有限，美國銀行全球研究認為，即使高價已開始抑制部分需求，柴油供應吃緊仍可能延續至2027年。
這波短缺的主要問題不在原油不足，而是原油無法順利加工成柴油，或成品油無法運往需求地區。
俄羅斯是目前最大的單一供給缺口。過去100天，烏克蘭約對俄羅斯燃料基礎設施發動50次攻擊，俄羅斯34座主要煉油廠中至少24座遭到波及。俄羅斯7月原油加工量降至每日390萬桶，接近20多年低點；即使部分設備完成修復，預估12月也只能回升至每日440萬桶。
煉油量下降已直接反映在出口。俄羅斯自7月8日起限制柴油出口，8月前七天柴油與粗柴油出口量降至每日8萬桶，不僅低於7月低點，也遠低於2025年底超過每日100萬桶的供應量。俄羅斯原為全球主要柴油出口國，出口驟降使其他地區更難補足缺口。
中東供應也同時受阻。波斯灣煉油廠受損，加上荷姆茲海峽航運中斷，削弱這個約占全球柴油出口三分之一地區的供應能力。俄羅斯與中東兩大出口來源同步收縮，使柴油市場無法只依靠區域調度恢復平衡。
物流問題進一步放大供應缺口。烏克蘭攻擊新羅西斯克港，限制哈薩克原油出口；約80%的哈薩克原油經由當地運出，並供應羅馬尼亞Petromidia煉油廠。多瑙河水位偏低也使燃料駁船無法滿載，黑海航運風險、裝載延遲與運費上漲，則增加成品油送往歐洲的成本。
供給收縮之際，柴油需求即將進入旺季。歐洲收割期提前，農業用油需求已開始增加；進入冬季後，運輸、工業與供暖需求還將上升。目前全球柴油與航空燃油庫存位於過去五年區間低端，摩根士丹利預估，歐洲柴油庫存年底可能降至多年低點。
美國銀行大宗商品策略師Francisco Blanch指出，農業需求增加、低庫存及持續供應中斷，可能超過高價造成的初步需求下降。除非供給明顯恢復，柴油市場到2027年仍可能維持供應吃緊、價格偏高及波動加劇。
替代供應能力同樣有限。美國與亞洲煉油廠已接近滿載，冬季來臨後還可能優先供應國內市場。Kpler分析師預估，到2027年第1季，美國墨西哥灣沿岸原本供應西北歐的部分柴油，可能轉往美國東岸滿足冬季取暖需求，使歐洲供應更加吃緊。
這也解釋為何原油價格下跌，柴油價格未必同步下降。歐洲原油與成品油價差已由每噸300至400美元擴大至650至700美元，反映市場真正短缺的是煉油產能與可供出口的成品油，而不是地下原油資源。
因此，IEA與OPEC下調石油需求預測、美國商業原油庫存增加，都不足以證明柴油供需已經轉鬆。對煉油業者而言，柴油裂解價差可能維持高檔；物流、航運、農業及其他大量使用柴油的產業，則將持續面臨燃料成本壓力。

items.title: 電價調幅追不上成本 韓國電力公司2026年淨利預估遭砍48%
items.title_en: Korea Electric Power's 2026 Net Profit Estimate Slashed by 48% Due to Insufficient Electricity Price Adjustments
paras: 2026年08月14日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 南韓電價調升幅度有限，卻碰上燃料與外購電力成本增加，韓國電力Korea Electric Power(015760-KS) 2026年獲利展望面臨下修。野村將韓電2026年淨利預估大砍48%至4.871兆韓元，ROE預估也由17.9%降至9.7%。
韓電的問題並非電力需求不足，而是售電價格調整速度追不上發電成本。燃料價格上升直接推高發電支出，外購電力成本增加也進一步壓縮利潤；相較之下，受管制電價只能小幅調整，成本難以完整轉嫁給用戶。
這使市場對韓電獲利正常化的預期出現落差。電價調升原本有助改善售電收益，但只要燃料與購電成本上升幅度更大，電價調整帶來的利益仍可能被抵銷。野村因此將韓電投資評等由買進降至中立，目標價也由61,000韓元下修至40,000韓元。

paras_en: On August 14, 2026, according to a report by Youjixing Industry Data Center, the limited adjustment of electricity prices in South Korea, coupled with the increase in fuel and external power purchase costs, has led to a downward revision of Korea Electric Power (015760-KS)'s 2026 profit forecast. Nomura has significantly reduced its estimate of Korea Electric Power's 2026 net profit by 48% to 4.871 trillion Korean won, with the ROE estimate also decreasing from 17.9% to 9.7%.

The issue faced by Korea Electric Power is not a lack of electricity demand, but rather the inability of the selling price to keep up with the generation cost. The rise in fuel prices directly increases the cost of power generation, while the increase in external power purchase costs further compresses profits. In contrast, regulated electricity prices can only be adjusted slightly, making it difficult to pass on costs to users.

This has led to a discrepancy in the market's expectations for Korea Electric Power's normalized profits. The adjustment of electricity prices was initially expected to improve sales revenue, but if the increase in fuel and power purchase costs is greater, the benefits brought by the price adjustment may still be offset. As a result, Nomura has downgraded its investment rating for Korea Electric Power from 'buy' to 'neutral' and reduced its target price from 61,000 Korean won to 40,000 Korean won.

items.title: VLEO衛星電力需求升高韓華投入300億韓元開發太空太陽能電池
paras: 2026年08月14日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 極低地球軌道(VLEO)衛星運行高度通常低於450km，因距離地面更近，可取得更清晰的地球觀測影像，但也更容易受到大氣阻力影響，需要消耗更多電力維持軌道，加上高解析度雷達、光學感測器與熱控制系統的用電需求，使電力供應成為影響衛星性能與使用壽命的關鍵。
然而，衛星的重量與太陽能板面積有限，無法單純透過增加太陽能板提高供電量，因此如何在有限面積下產生更多電力，成為VLEO衛星的重要技術課題，也帶動高效率、輕量化且能承受太空輻射與原子氧侵蝕的太陽能電池需求。
看準這項需求，韓華解決方案Hanwha Solutions旗下Qcells與韓華系統Hanwha Systems展開合作，計畫至2028年投入300億韓元，共同開發衛星用高效率串聯式(Tandem)太陽能電池與面板，鎖定VLEO衛星電力市場。
雙方將結合Qcells的太陽能電池技術與Hanwha Systems的衛星開發能力，預計2028年前透過測試衛星完成技術驗證，並於2029年評估導入Hanwha Systems規劃的64顆VLEO超高解析度合成孔徑雷達(SAR)衛星計畫，目標達到0.15m級解析度。

items.title: AI熱潮推升亞洲市場 台幣升破32元、韓股走強
paras: 2026年08月14日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI投資熱潮持續推升亞洲科技股與區域貨幣。台幣週五盤中一度升值0.6%至31.991元兌1美元，創7月8日以來最強水準，並連續第3個交易日走升，本週累計升值近1%，可望創2025年9月初以來最佳單週表現。
由於台灣接近股利發放旺季尾聲，海外股東將股利兌換成外幣的需求逐漸減弱，有助舒緩台幣貶值壓力。市場分析人士認為，美元兌台幣接近32.5元時，除了可能吸引出口商將美元兌回台幣，央行過去也曾在類似價位進場穩定匯市。
台股上漲0.2%，權值股台積電TSMC(2330-TW)走強提供支撐。受惠先進AI晶片需求強勁，台積電今年表現突出，並持續帶動台股大盤。
AI行情也延燒至南韓，KOSPI指數盤中一度大漲近3%，升至近3週高點，韓元則升值0.3%。科技股漲勢進一步推升亞洲新興市場，MSCI亞洲新興市場股票指數上漲0.4%，MSCI新興市場資訊科技指數上漲0.8%。
經濟數據方面，馬來西亞2026年第2季GDP成長6%，優於市場預期，主要受出口成長加快及家庭支出穩健帶動。令吉升值約0.1%，馬來西亞主要股價指數則下跌0.3%。

items.title: AI時代「記憶體即石油」 ！SK集團會長崔泰源：2027年將是晶片短缺最慘烈一年
paras: 南韓SK集團會長近日接受《CNBC》專訪時就7200億美元擴產賭注、與黃仁勳私交、HBM供應瓶頸、美國建廠壓力與AI 對人類社會的深遠影響進行深度討論，這位掌管逾百家子公司的南韓財閥掌門人罕見地坦承：「2027年可能是記憶體短缺最嚴重一年，所有人都想要更多晶片，但我們給不出來。」
SK集團旗下擁有超過100家子公司，但崔泰源毫不諱言，目前集團最核心的引擎是SK海力士。他比喻道：「現在是AI時代，AI就像一個四歲小孩，隨著它成長，需要更多功能、更多經驗和知識，而這些都必須存在某個地方。」
為支撐這波需求，SK海力士已宣布未來五年投入高達7200億美元擴建產能。崔泰源預估，未來五年全球AI智能體數量將較 2025 年暴增 77 倍，十年內記憶體總需求將逼近當前產能的五倍。「我們必須迅速擴張，否則供應跟不上。」
他進一步指出，目前DRAM(含HBM)約佔SK海力士營收的四分之三。但這波擴產並非盲目衝量，HBM生產佔用的晶圓產能是普通DRAM的4倍以上，大幅擠壓整體晶圓空間。
SK集團已意識到過剩風險，正透過長期協議(LTA)、晶圓廠合資與「記憶體即服務」(MaaS)等模式分攤風險。崔泰源說：「我們每次擴張都會檢查需求是否真實存在，既不希望供過於求，也不希望供不應求。」
訪談中最令人警醒的一段，是崔泰源對「晶片通膨」的坦承。他透露，記憶體價格今年來已漲40%至50%，就連蘋果這類消費電子巨頭都不得不將成本轉嫁給消費者。
崔泰源說：「晶片價格太高，結果就是全社會的價格水平都會被推高。我並不希望如此，但它已經發生了。」
更嚴峻的是供給缺口。崔泰源直言擴建一座晶圓廠至少需要四到五年準備期，而「明年可能是最艱難的一年」。沒有一家記憶體公司準備好擴大產能，但需求料將較今年翻倍。「這就像一場戰爭，每個人都想要更多記憶體晶片。」他甚至證實，南韓各地飯店早已擠滿前來簽署LTA的全球科技巨頭高層。
崔泰源在訪談中展現驚人的「人脈版圖」。他展示一片有黃仁勳簽名的晶圓，並透露與微軟執行長Satya Nadella、谷歌執行長Sundar Pichai、Meta執行長Mark Zuckerberg等超大规模雲端客戶負責人都是朋友，經常交流產業展望。
當談及台積電，崔泰源稱約一個月前才跟魏哲家會面。「沒有基礎裸片(base die)就無法生產 AI 產品。我相信他當然會為我們生產。」
他也強調，台積電與SK海力士是互補關係，記憶體充足但台積電產能有限，GPU照樣出不來，反之亦然。
對於輝達作為最大客戶的集中度風險，崔泰源並不避諱地說，「沒有輝達，今天的AI生態系就不會存在。我必須盡我所能支持他」，但稱谷歌、微軟等客戶也自行設計晶片，並非單一依賴。
針對華府近期施壓SK海力士與三星在美建立完整記憶體晶圓廠一事，崔泰源坦言，美國客戶確實希望SK海力士在美設廠，但稱建廠決策不能草率。「一座晶圓廠背後需要600至700家材料、化學品與服務供應商組成的產業生態系。除水、電、土地外，生態系同樣是關鍵。」
目前，SK海力士已在印第安納州推進項目，並成立「美國AI公司」與投入100億美元，目標是結合美國軟體實力與亞洲硬體製造優勢。此外，SK海力士已進入美國資本市場融資，為全球擴張與人才激勵打開新資金管道。
訪談尾聲，崔泰源對記憶體產業的週期性提出深刻見解。他表示，過去記憶體景氣取決於全球人口數量與硬體設備數量，「人們不會一天買十支手機，但AI時代不同，一個人可能同時擁有十個不同的AI智能體，每個智能體都需要大量記憶體。
崔泰源說：「週期不會消失，但運行方式必然改變，它可能變成一個長得多的週期。」
從1997年金融危機時的瀕臨破產，到2023年的艱困調整，崔泰源認為這次最大不同是「AI 這個新生兒」。他既看到AI消耗大量能源、水與材料的挑戰，也相信AI將解放人類勞動、縮小社會差距。
崔泰源說：「我們不必再那麼辛苦地工作，如果人與人之間的差異也隨之縮小，就更有機會建設一個幸福的社會。」
在記憶體這條被稱為「現代石油」的賽道上，崔泰源正帶領SK海力士押上全部身家，而他的判斷只有一句話：「至少在不久的將來，我看到需求仍會非常強勁，這一點是確定的。」

items.title: 頂尖研究員余家輝宣布離開 Meta祭高薪挖角卻仍難留住人才
paras: Meta 超級智能實驗室(Meta Superintelligence Labs, MSL)核心成員、多模態研究負責人余家輝(Jiahui Yu)周五(14日)正式宣布離職，並計畫創辦新公司。
余家輝自 2025 年 6 月加入 Meta 以來，帶領團隊推出了 Muse 系列原生多模態模型，是 Meta 近年來在生成式人工智慧(Generative AI)領域的重要戰力。

從學霸到頂尖工程師

余家輝的學術與職業生涯始終環繞著「多模態」技術。他出身於中國科學技術大學少年班，隨後取得伊利諾大學厄巴納－香檳分校(UIUC)博士學位，師從知名電腦視覺學者黃煦濤。
在進入 Meta 之前，他已是 AI 界公認的頂尖人才，曾參與 Google 的 Gemini 專案，並擔任 OpenAI 感知(Perception)團隊負責人，主導 GPT-4o 及 o 系列推理模型的研發。
加入 Meta 後，余家輝擔任超級智能實驗室旗下 TBD Lab 的多模態技術負責人。他在離職公告中表示，過去一年在 Meta 與執行長祖克柏(Mark Zuckerberg)及首席 AI 官 Alexandr Wang 共同建設 TBD Lab 的經歷
「極具啟發且充實」。

Muse 系列產品線完備

在余家輝任職的 14 個月內，TBD Lab 完成了密集的產品發布。從 2026 年 4 月推出的基礎模型 Muse Spark 開始，標誌著 Meta 的前沿模型研發重心從 Llama 系列轉向更具備多模態能力的 Muse 系列。隨後，團隊接連推出 Voice Mode、Muse Image 與 Muse Video，全面覆蓋語音、影像與影片生成領域。
就在他宣布辭職前八天，Meta 才剛發布 Muse Spark 1.2，進一步強化了智慧代理人(Agent)能力與長程任務執行潛力。

九位數年薪爭議

關於余家輝的待遇，市場曾盛傳 Meta 以高達「1 億美元年薪」的創紀錄條件將他從 OpenAI 挖角。儘管 Meta 並未證實確切數字，但 CTO Andrew Bosworth曾針對市場傳言澄清，所謂的高額報酬並非一次性領取的簽約獎金，而是包含股票、獎金與績效條件的四年期總酬勞方案。
針對這種重金挖角的現象，OpenAI 執行長 Sam Altman 曾評論認為：「傳教士最終會擊敗僱傭兵(Missionaries will eventually beat the mercenaries)」。
隨著余家輝在短期內完成階段性任務後離職創業，科技作者 Gergely Orosz 指出，Meta 內部的組織重組與效率調整導致工程師產生不安感，許多資深專家開始對外部機會保持開放態度。

Meta 面臨人才流失挑戰

關於創業動向，余家輝並未透露新公司的細節，僅表示一個「對人類未來極其重要，但目前尚未被充分探索的問題」正吸引著他全部的注意力。
研究平台 alphaXiv 數據顯示，包含余家輝在內，Meta 已流失超過 200 名知名研究員，總計有 929 位研究人員處於「曾在 Meta 工作但已離職」的狀態。雖然 Meta 能夠透過短期高額報酬追趕技術差距，但如何修復組織信任並留住頂尖人才，仍是未來的重要挑戰。

items.title: 〈台幣〉一度升破32元大關 收32.046元 強升1.22角
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Briefly Broke the 32‑Per‑Dollar Barrier, Closing at 32.046, a Strong Rise of 1.22 Cents
paras: 新台幣今(14)日再度呈現強升格局，全日處升值態勢，更一度升破32元大關，終場收在32.046元，升值1.22角，台北外匯經紀公司成交值擴大至22.28億美元。
新台幣今日以32.15元、升值1.8分開出後，最高來到31.991元，全日高低價差1.59元。
觀察主要亞幣，新台幣收升0.38%，韓元也升值逾0.3%，日元升近0.2%，人民幣、星元小升約0.05%上下，泰銖則小貶0.05%。
統一投顧表示，美國 7 月 CPI 月增 0.1%，符合市場預期，而核心PPI 月增 0.2%，則低於市場預期的 0.3%，進一步緩解市場對聯準會 9 月升息的擔憂。
元大投顧則指出，美國 7 月非農就業人口意外下滑，且最新 CPI 數據如常，使市場擔憂升息程度減輕不少，預期 8 月底全球央行年會前聯準會不至於出現過於鷹派的言論。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar again showed a strong upward trend today (the 14th), staying in appreciation mode throughout the day and at one point breaking the 32‑per‑dollar mark, ultimately closing at 32.046, a gain of 1.22 cents, with the Taipei foreign‑exchange brokerage’s transaction volume expanding to US$2.228 billion.
The New Taiwan dollar opened at 32.15, up 0.18 cents, and rose to a high of 31.991 during the session, with a daily price range of 1.59 cents.

Among the major Asian currencies, the New Taiwan dollar closed up 0.38%, the Korean won also appreciated by more than 0.3%, the Japanese yen rose nearly 0.2%, the Chinese yuan and Singapore dollar each inched up about 0.05%, while the Thai baht slipped about 0.05%.

Unified Investment Advisory noted that U.S. CPI for July rose 0.1% month‑over‑month, in line with market expectations, while core PPI rose 0.2% month‑over‑month, below the expected 0.3%, further easing concerns about a September rate hike by the Federal Reserve.

Yuanta Investment Advisory pointed out that U.S. non‑farm payrolls unexpectedly fell in July and the latest CPI data came in as expected, reducing market worries about the extent of future rate hikes, and they anticipate that the Fed is unlikely to adopt an overly hawkish tone before the global central‑bank meetings at the end of August.

items.title: 干預越多、空頭笑越大聲！高盛：日本15年來最大干預引發日元套利部位大幅平倉
items.title_en: Intervention Fuels Short Selling as Goldman Sachs Sees Largest Intervention in 15 Years
paras: 高盛週五(14日)出具研究報告指出，日本15年來最大規模的外匯干預，非但沒能扭轉日元頹勢，反而替市場「創造了更高價位拋售日元」的戰術窗口。
美日兩國上月底罕見聯手買入日元，一度將美元兌日元從逼近163拉回155附近，但不到兩週便再度滑向160大關，今日日圓兌美元在亞洲匯市早盤報159.46。
高盛策略師Karen Reichgott Fishman表示，此次干預引發的戰術性日元套利平倉規模，已超過2024年7月那輪干預後的初期平倉量。若宏觀環境轉向支撐日元，部位甚至可能翻為淨多頭，重演2024年夏天的劇本，但當前日美利差仍大，日本利率僅約1%，遠低於多數發達經濟體，借低利日元、買高息資產的套利交易利潤空間依舊誘人。
另據摩根大通與道富數據，截至8月4日，避險基金已砍掉一半看空日元押注，但部分資金正回流套利池。
Alpha Binwani Capital創辦人Ashwin Binwani說：「干預給了我們在更好價位賣日元的絕佳機會，套利交易太香了，不能錯過。」
道富東京分行經理Bart Wakabayashi也表示，實錢帳戶仍保留套利持倉，日元兌澳元、歐元、美元、加元、英鎊皆被持續賣出。今年做空日元兌哥倫比亞比索、土耳其里拉、挪威克朗的組合報酬率均超過10%。
當前風險在於，空頭回補越積越多，官方再度出手機率同步攀升。過去一週日元已吐回干預帶來的一半左右升幅，財政壓力與利差因素未消除前，160關卡仍是市場與東京當局的敏感紅線。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs released a research report on Friday (14th) stating that Japan's largest foreign exchange intervention in 15 years has not only failed to reverse the yen's decline, but has instead created a higher price point for selling yen.

The US and Japan jointly purchased yen at the end of last month, temporarily pushing the dollar-yen exchange rate from near 163 to around 155, but it slid back to the 160 level in less than two weeks. The yen-dollar exchange rate in Asian markets opened at 159.46 today.

Goldman Sachs strategist Karen Reichgott Fishman stated that the tactical yen short selling scale triggered by this intervention has exceeded the initial scale of short selling after the intervention in July 2024. If the macro environment turns to support the yen, the position may even turn into a net long position, replaying the script from the summer of 2024, but the current US-Japan interest rate difference is still large, and Japan's interest rate is only around 1%, far lower than most developed economies, making the low-yen, high-yield asset trading profit space still attractive.
According to data from Morgan Stanley and UBS, as of August 4, hedge funds have cut their yen short selling bets by half, but some funds are returning to the arbitrage pool.
Alpha Binwani Capital founder Ashwin Binwani said, 'The intervention gave us an excellent opportunity to sell yen at a better price, and the arbitrage trading is too tempting to miss.'

UBS Tokyo branch manager Bart Wakabayashi also stated that real money accounts still hold arbitrage positions, and yen against Australian dollar, euro, US dollar, Canadian dollar, and British pound are being continuously sold. The return on investment for short selling yen against Colombian peso, Turkish lira, and Norwegian krone this year has all exceeded 10%.

The current risk is that the short selling rebound will accumulate more and more, and the official intervention will increase in probability. The yen has already recovered about half of the upward momentum brought by the intervention in the past week, and the fiscal pressure and interest rate factors have not been eliminated, so the 160 level is still a sensitive red line for the market and the Tokyo authorities.

Bloomberg cited insiders saying Prime Minister Kishida’s government backs a near‑term hike, reflecting US Treasury Secretary Yellen’s push after joint intervention for Japan to adopt tighter policy, hinting a shift from dovish stance and allowing BOJ rate hikes. The yield spread between Japanese and US Treasuries is expected to narrow further, providing support for the yen.

Subsequently, the US Labor Department reported initial jobless claims rising to 209,000. July’s final PPI held steady month‑over‑month and fell to 4.7% year‑over‑year, bolstering expectations the Fed will hold rates steady next month. Richmond Fed President Barkin said cooling inflation reduces the need for hikes, pushing the dollar‑yen down to a low of 159.01, while Cleveland Fed President Harker reiterated that the Fed should raise rates promptly to curb inflation. items.title: 挪威央行維持利率4.25%不變 通膨風險與地緣政治仍令政策前景蒙陰
items.title_en: Norway Central Bank Keeps Interest Rate at 4.25% as Inflation and Geopolitical Risks Loom
paras: 挪威央行周四(13日)宣布將基準利率維持在 4.25% 保持不變，此一決定完全符合市場預期，媒體對 16 位分析師進行的調查均準確預測了此結果。
儘管通膨壓力近期有所緩解，但委員會認為仍需維持緊縮的貨幣政策，以確保通膨能在合理時間內回落至目標水準。
挪威央行總裁巴克(Ida Wolden Bache)在聲明中指出，今年夏季的通膨數據低於預期，這是一個令人欣慰的消息，但目前的通膨率依然過高。她強調，現在得出通膨前景已發生實質性變化的結論還為時過早，因此「未來仍有必要提高政策利率」。
雖然挪威近兩個月的核心物價增長出人意料地溫和，讓官員有空間觀察這座能源資源豐富的經濟體是否正在降溫，但推動國內物價的關鍵因素——包括強勁的薪資增長與緊繃的勞動力市場——依然穩固。此外，央行特別提到，中東地區的持續衝突也為全球通膨前景增加了不確定性。
在利率決議公布後，挪威克朗兌歐元匯率小幅走弱 0.2% 至 10.9684。分析師對於 9 月是否會進行最後一次升息看法分歧。丹麥銀行(Danske Bank)首席經濟學家 Jullum 認為，8 月的核心通膨可能再次攀升至 3% 以上，這將迫使央行在 9 月採取行動，儘管這將是一個「艱難的抉擇」。目前交易員預計 9 月升息的可能性已從先前的預期略微下修。
挪威央行預計將在 9 月發布新的通膨預測與政策路徑報告，屆時將提供更多關於利率走向的明確指引。
paras_en: The Norwegian central bank announced on Thursday (13th) that it would maintain the benchmark interest rate at 4.25% unchanged, a decision that fully met market expectations, with all 16 analysts surveyed by the media accurately predicting the outcome.

Although inflationary pressures have eased in recent periods, the committee believes that it is still necessary to maintain a tight monetary policy to ensure that inflation returns to its target level in a reasonable time.

Norwegian Central Bank Governor Ida Wolden Bache stated in a statement that the summer inflation data were lower than expected, which is a welcome news, but the current inflation rate is still too high. She emphasized that it is too early to conclude that the inflation outlook has undergone a substantial change, and therefore, "it is still necessary to raise policy interest rates in the future."

Although Norway's core inflation rate has been unexpectedly mild over the past two months, giving officials some room to observe whether the economy is cooling down, the key drivers of domestic prices, including strong wage growth and a tight labor market, remain solid. In addition, the central bank specifically mentioned that the ongoing conflicts in the Middle East have increased uncertainty about the global inflation outlook.

After the interest rate decision was announced, the Norwegian krone depreciated against the euro by 0.2% to 10.9684. Analysts are divided on whether there will be a final rate hike in September. Danske Bank Chief Economist Jullum believes that the core inflation rate may rise again to above 3% in August, which would force the central bank to take action in September, although this would be a "difficult choice." Currently, traders have slightly reduced their expectations for a rate hike in September.
The Norwegian central bank plans to release new inflation forecasts and policy path reports in September, which will provide more explicit guidance on the direction of interest rates.

items.title: 〈台幣〉聯準會升息機率降 升值7.8分收32.168元
items.title_en: TWD Rises as Fed Rate Hike Probability Decreases, Closes at 32.168
paras: 隨著外資回補台股，台北匯市受到帶動今(13)日續強，新台幣全日處在升值態勢，終場收32.168元，升值7.8分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值較昨日擴大至17.22億美元。
新台幣今日以32.22元、升值2.6分開出後，最高來到32.152元，全日高低價差6.8分。
觀察主要亞幣，以新台幣表現較強勁，收升0.24%，美元指數微跌0.02%左右，日元和人民幣小升0.02%上下，星元微貶不到0.05%，泰銖貶約0.1%，韓元則重挫近0.5%。
國泰證期研究部分析，美國 7 月 CPI 年增率降至 3.4%、核心 CPI 降至 2.5%，通膨降溫，惟服務價格仍具黏性，加上油價逼近 90 美元，能源通膨風險仍在，預期聯準會短期維持利率不變。
群益投顧也表示，美國7月CPI低於6月的3.5%，核心CPI也從6月的2.6%降至2.5%，皆與市場預期一致，儘管仍明顯高於聯準會設定的2%目標，但與6月數據同樣維持平穩，顯示今年稍早由能源價格推動的通膨正在降溫，市場預期9月聯準會升息機率續降。
paras_en: As foreign capital returns to the Taiwanese stock market, the Taipei foreign exchange market was boosted today, with the New Taiwan dollar (TWD) continuing to rise, closing at 32.168, up 7.8 points, and the trading value of the Taipei Foreign Exchange Brokerage Company expanded to $17.22 billion, compared to the previous day.
The TWD opened at 32.22, up 2.6 points, and rose to a high of 32.152 during the day, with a daily high-low price difference of 6.8 points.

Among major Asian currencies, the TWD performed relatively strongly, rising 0.24%, while the US dollar index fell slightly by about 0.02%, the Japanese yen and the Chinese yuan rose slightly by around 0.02%, the Singapore dollar fell by less than 0.05%, the Thai baht fell by about 0.1%, and the Korean won plummeted by nearly 0.5%.

According to Cathay Futures research, the US July CPI annual growth rate fell to 3.4%, and the core CPI fell to 2.5%, indicating a decline in inflation, but service prices still have stickiness, and with oil prices approaching $90, energy inflation risks still exist, and it is expected that the Federal Reserve will maintain interest rates in the short term.

Yuanta Securities Investment Advisory also stated that the US July CPI was lower than June's 3.5%, and the core CPI also fell from June's 2.6% to 2.5%, both of which were in line with market expectations, although they were still significantly higher than the Federal Reserve's 2% target, but remained stable compared to June's data, indicating that the inflation driven by energy prices earlier this year is easing, and the market expects the probability of a Fed rate hike in September to continue to decline.

items.title: 日元走強 高市早苗政府傳支持近期升息
items.title_en: Yen Rises as Kishida Government Said to Support Near-Term Rate Hike
paras: 據知情人士透露，日本首相高市早苗領導的政府目前正轉向支持日本央行(BOJ)於近期升息，預計下一次調升利率的時機最快將落在今年 9 月或 10 月。
這項立場轉變的核心考量在於，日元持續疲軟已推高進口物價並加劇生活成本危機，政府希望透過貨幣政策的配合，強化美日聯合匯率干預的效果。
此消息對市場產生即時衝擊，日元兌美元匯率一度從 159.46 走強至 159.18 附近，日本國債期貨則隨之下跌，基準 10 年期國債殖利率微幅上升。市場目前正密切關注 9 月 18 日的政策會議，交易員預期屆時升息的機率已高達 74%。
高市早苗過去一向被視為對快速升息持保留態度，擔心過早收緊貨幣會扼殺經濟復甦，但在日元貶值引發選民不滿的背景下，政府內部對緊縮政策的容忍度顯著提高。若央行在 12 個月內完成第三次升息，將創下自 1989 年資產泡沫巔峰以來最快的緊縮步調。
雖然日本政府強調尊重央行的法律獨立性，但雙方需就經濟目標保持密切聯繫。日本央行總裁植田和男此前已暗示，面對物價上行的風險，不排除加快升息步伐。
此外，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)也曾表示，日本央行有必要加入支撐日元的行動。在政府與央行 2013 年簽署的共同協議框架下，雙方正朝著穩定實現 2% 通膨目標的方向協作，這也為近期的政策轉向奠定了政治基礎。
paras_en: According to informed sources, the government led by Japanese Prime Minister Kishida Fumio is now shifting towards supporting the Bank of Japan (BOJ) in raising interest rates in the near term, with the next rate hike expected to occur as early as September or October this year.

The core consideration behind this shift in stance is that the prolonged weakness of the yen has driven up import prices and exacerbated the cost-of-living crisis, and the government hopes to enhance the effectiveness of joint US-Japan currency intervention through monetary policy coordination.

This news has had an immediate impact on the market, with the yen strengthening against the US dollar from 159.46 to around 159.18, and Japanese government bond futures falling, with the benchmark 10-year bond yield rising slightly. The market is closely watching the policy meeting on September 18, with traders expecting a 74% chance of a rate hike at that time.

Kishida Fumio has been seen as cautious about rapid rate hikes in the past, fearing that premature tightening of monetary policy could stifle economic recovery, but in the context of the yen's depreciation triggering voter discontent, the government's tolerance for tightening policies has increased significantly. If the central bank completes its third rate hike within 12 months, it will be the fastest tightening pace since the peak of the asset bubble in 1989.

Although the Japanese government emphasizes respect for the central bank's legal independence, the two sides need to maintain close contact on economic targets. BOJ Governor Ueda Kazuo has previously hinted that, faced with the risk of rising prices, he does not rule out accelerating the pace of rate hikes.

Additionally, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has also stated that the Bank of Japan needs to join in supporting the yen. Under the joint agreement framework signed by the government and the central bank in 2013, both sides are working together to achieve the 2% inflation target, which has also laid the political foundation for the recent policy shift.

items.title: 美國干預日元反而更危險？《財富》警告市場恐被「大玩家」綁架
items.title_en: Is U.S. Intervention in the Yen More Dangerous? Fortune Warns the Market May Be Hijacked by a “Big Player”
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）與日本財務省聯手干預外匯市場，試圖推動日元升至他眼中「更合理」的水準。然而，這場看似為穩定匯市而來的行動，可能反而釋放出更危險的訊號：當市場開始揣摩政策官員的一言一行，而非依循經濟基本面定價，匯市波動恐怕不減反增。
貝森特先前接受福斯財經網（Fox Business）訪問時直言，日元遭到「嚴重低估」，並認為貨幣「過度波動」並不健康，等同公開質疑市場形成的日元價格。隨著貝森特與日本財務省採取行動，日元隨即走強，但這波升勢究竟能否持續，仍有待觀察。
「大玩家」進場 市場定價邏輯生變
日元走強有兩項主要原因。首先是相關機構直接買進日元；其次，也是影響更大的因素，是貝森特與日本財務大臣片山皋月透過公開發言向市場施壓。兩人均明確表態希望日元升值，並準備透過干預措施支撐疲弱的日元。
《財富》分析指出，這種足以透過言論與行動改變市場走勢的政策人物，是市場中的「大玩家」。「大玩家」最大的特徵，在於其決策不必遵循簡單、明確的規則，而是高度依賴個人判斷。當市場無法預測其下一步行動，政策干預本身就可能成為新的不確定性來源。
歷史教訓：干預可能放大波動
以19世紀俄羅斯的經驗為例。1887年，維什涅格拉茨基（Ivan Vyshnegradsky）出任沙俄財政大臣後，積極操縱盧布兌德國馬克匯率，其干預最終加劇市場波動。繼任者維特（Sergei Witte）則改變方向，放棄裁量式干預，並於1897年推動盧布錨定金本位制。
相關央行干預研究顯示，捍衛貨幣升值與刻意拉高匯率，兩者效果並不相同；相較之下，以明確規則為基礎的制度能降低這類不對稱風險。
換言之，規則提供市場可預測性，而「大玩家」式的裁量干預，反而可能放大波動。
「財政部觀察」恐取代基本面
真正值得警惕的，是貝森特成為外匯市場「大玩家」後可能帶來的連鎖效應。《財富》認為，市場未來可能催生新的「財政部觀察」模式，交易員將緊盯貝森特的每一次發言，逐字解讀他的評論，甚至追逐未經證實的政策傳聞。
一旦這種交易模式形成，真正左右匯率的可能不再只是經濟基本面，而是市場對貝森特下一步行動的猜測，以及對其他交易員猜測的再猜測。
《財富》警告，這將助長羊群效應與噪音交易，使市場參與者把更多精力投入預測政策人物的態度變化，而非分析基本面。
因此，貝森特干預日元真正危險之處，或許不只是日元究竟應該升到什麼價位，而是市場定價機制本身可能發生改變。當交易員開始追逐「大玩家」的一舉一動，政策原本試圖壓低的波動，反而可能因此被進一步放大。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, working together with Japan’s Ministry of Finance, intervened in the foreign‑exchange market in an effort to push the yen up to what he sees as a more reasonable level. Yet this action, which appears aimed at stabilising the market, may actually send a more dangerous signal: when the market starts to read every word and move of policy officials instead of pricing based on economic fundamentals, currency volatility could increase rather than decrease.

In a prior interview with Fox Business, Bessent bluntly said the yen was "severely undervalued" and that its "excessive volatility" was unhealthy, essentially questioning the market‑determined price of the yen. After Bessent and the Japanese finance ministry took action, the yen immediately appreciated, but whether this rally can be sustained remains to be seen.
“Big Player” Enters, Changing Market‑Pricing Logic

The yen’s strength stems from two main drivers. First, the relevant authorities are directly buying yen. Second, and more impactful, is the pressure Bessent and Japanese Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki apply to the market through public statements. Both have made it clear they want a stronger yen and are prepared to back a weak yen with intervention measures.

Fortune’s analysis points out that policy figures capable of moving markets through words and deeds are the market’s “big players.” The hallmark of a big player is that their decisions do not follow simple, transparent rules but rely heavily on personal judgment. When the market cannot predict their next move, the intervention itself becomes a new source of uncertainty.
Historical Lesson: Intervention Can Amplify Volatility

Take 19th‑century Russia as an example. In 1887, Ivan Vyshnegradsky, as finance minister of the Tsarist regime, actively manipulated the ruble‑to‑German‑mark exchange rate, and his interventions ultimately heightened market volatility. His successor, Sergei Witte, changed course, abandoning discretionary intervention and, in 1897, anchoring the ruble to the gold standard.

Research on central‑bank interventions shows that defending a currency’s appreciation and deliberately pushing a rate higher produce different outcomes; by contrast, rule‑based systems can reduce such asymmetric risks.
In other words, rules give the market predictability, whereas discretionary “big‑player” interventions may actually magnify volatility.
“Treasury Watch” May Supplant Fundamentals

The real danger lies in the chain reaction that could follow Bessent’s emergence as a foreign‑exchange “big player.” Fortune believes the market may give rise to a new “Treasury Watch” paradigm, where traders obsess over every utterance from Bessent, parsing his comments word‑by‑word and even chasing unverified policy rumours.

If such a trading style takes hold, the forces truly moving exchange rates may no longer be economic fundamentals but speculation about Bessent’s next step and the subsequent guesses of other traders about those guesses.

Fortune warns this will fuel herd behaviour and noise trading, causing market participants to devote more energy to forecasting the attitude shifts of policy figures rather than analysing fundamentals.

Thus, the real danger of Bessent’s yen intervention may not be the specific level to which the yen should rise, but the potential alteration of the market‑pricing mechanism itself. When traders start chasing every move of the “big player,” the volatility that policy originally sought to suppress could be amplified further.
